Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the quality or power that something or someone has that makes it, him, or her attractive

examples.en: the lure of fame/power/money
examples.trans: 名譽／權力／金錢的誘惑

examples.en: She was lured into the job by the offer of a high salary.
examples.trans: 她受高薪誘惑接受了那份工作。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to persuade someone to do something or go somewhere by offering them something exciting

examples.en: the lure of fame/power/money
examples.trans: 名譽／權力／金錢的誘惑

examples.en: She was lured into the job by the offer of a high salary.
examples.trans: 她受高薪誘惑接受了那份工作。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: very comfortable and expensive

examples.en: They have a very luxurious house.
examples.trans: 他們有一座十分豪華的房子。

examples.en: We spent a luxurious weekend at a country hotel.
examples.trans: 我們在一家鄉村飯店度過了一個奢華的週末。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: something expensive that is pleasant to have but is not necessary

examples.en: to live in luxury
examples.trans: 生活奢華

examples.en: a luxury cruise
examples.trans: 豪華巡遊

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: considered normal, and having or using ideas, beliefs, etc. that are accepted by most people

examples.en: This is the director's first mainstream Hollywood film.
examples.trans: 這是該導演的首部好萊塢主流影片。

examples.en: The new law should allow more disabled people to enter the mainstream of American life.
examples.trans: 這部新法有望使更多的殘障人士融入美國的主流社會。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to express firmly your belief that something is true

examples.en: The army has been brought in to maintain order in the region.
examples.trans: 軍隊已調配到這個地區來維持秩序。

examples.en: We have standards to maintain.
examples.trans: 我們要堅持原則。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If you make room/space/way for something or someone, you move your body or move other things, so that there is space for it, him, or her.

examples.en: Do you want me to make some coffee?
examples.trans: 我煮些咖啡好嗎？

examples.en: He made a chocolate cake.
examples.trans: 他做了一個巧克力蛋糕。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to make something appear stupid or wrong, or to spoil something

examples.en: His repeated lack of promotion makes nonsense of the theory that if you work hard you'll be successful.
examples.trans: 他屢次得不到提升，這令「只要努力就會成功」的理論成了無稽之談。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to become famous or respected by a lot of people

examples.en: He's made a name for himself as a talented journalist.
examples.trans: 他為自己贏得天才記者的名聲。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.word: make a point of doing sth
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to always do something or to take particular care to do something

examples.en: She makes a point of keeping all her shopping receipts.
examples.trans: 她總是把所有的購物發票都保留下來。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to become suddenly very successful or very well known
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 一飛衝天，一炮而紅，一舉成名

examples.en: Jodie Foster made quite a splash in the film "Taxi Driver".
examples.trans: 茱蒂•福斯特因電影《計程車司機》而一舉成名。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.word: make a your mark on sth
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to have an important effect on something

examples.en: Daniel didn't work here for very long, but he definitely made his mark on the place.
examples.trans: 丹尼爾在這裡工作時間不長，但他卻實實在在地留下了深遠的影響。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to manage to live without things that you would like to have or with things of a worse quality than you would like

examples.en: We didn't have cupboards so we made do with boxes.
examples.trans: 我們沒有櫥櫃，只好將就用箱子了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: Indian English make both ends meet to have just enough money to pay for the things that you need
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 使收支相抵；勉強維持生計

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to be very successful

examples.en: She's very ambitious but I doubt she'll ever make it to the top.
examples.trans: 她很有抱負，但我懷疑她究竟能否成功。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to make someone extremely angry

examples.en: The way they have treated those people makes my blood boil.
examples.trans: 他們對待那些人的方式令我非常氣憤。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to make someone happy

examples.en: Seeing Adrian again after such a long time really made my day.
examples.trans: 過了這麼久能與阿德里安再次見面真讓我感到高興。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.word: make sth sb of sth sb
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to have an impression or an understanding about something

examples.en: Can you make anything of this information?
examples.trans: 你怎麼看這個消息？

examples.en: What do you make of the new boss? (= What is your impression of her?)
examples.trans: 你認為新老闆如何？

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to make certain you have some time when you are not busy in order to do something you think you should do

examples.en: It's important to make time to read to your children.
examples.trans: 騰出一點時間唸書給你的孩子聽很重要。

examples.en: In a relationship you have to make time for each other.
examples.trans: 戀愛中的男女必須為彼此擠出點時間。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to be very active so that other people notice you, often in a way that intentionally causes trouble

examples.en: It's probably not a good idea to start making waves in your first week in a new job.
examples.trans: 剛開始新工作的第一週就挑起事端可能不是個好主意。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to have a strong effect on other people or on a situation
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 突顯自己；（對人群或局勢）發揮作用

examples.en: The new police chief has really made his presence felt.
examples.trans: 新警長的確很引人注目。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to be successful and make progress in your life and work
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （在生活或工作上）獲得成功，飛黃騰達

examples.en: He will teach you how to build a career and make your way in the world.
examples.trans: 他會教你怎麼開啟事業並且在這世上飛黃騰達。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to relax and make yourself comfortable in someone else's home

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to communicate effectively
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 把自己的意思表達清楚

examples.en: Since they spoke only Swahili, we used signs and gestures to make ourselves understood.
examples.trans: 因爲他們只會說斯瓦希裡語，因此我們就借助動作和手勢讓對方明白我們的意思。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to write something down or remember it carefully

examples.en: I'll just take a note of your name and address.
examples.trans: 我只記一下你的姓名和地址。

examples.en: She made a mental note of the title.
examples.trans: 她牢牢地記住了標題。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: intended to harm or upset other people
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 惡意的，惡毒的，意在傷人的

examples.en: a malicious look in his eyes
examples.trans: 他惡狠狠的眼神

examples.en: He complained that he'd been receiving malicious phone calls.
examples.trans: 他抱怨說他接二連三地接到惡意騷擾電話。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: any animal of which the female feeds her young on milk from her own body. Most mammals give birth to live young, not eggs.

examples.en: Humans, dogs, elephants, and dolphins are all mammals, but birds, fish, and crocodiles are not.
examples.trans: 人、狗、大象和海豚都是哺乳動物，而鳥、魚和鱷魚則不是。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a very large, expensive house

examples.en: The street is lined with enormous mansions where the rich and famous live.
examples.trans: 街道兩旁是富人及名人的大豪宅。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: an event in which a large number of people walk through a public place to express their support for something, or their disagreement with or disapproval of something

examples.en: She's going on a march on Saturday in protest over the closure of the hospital.
examples.trans: 她將在週六參加一個反對關閉醫院的示威遊行。

examples.en: a funeral march
examples.trans: 葬禮進行曲

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to walk somewhere quickly and in a determined way, often because you are angry

examples.en: She's going on a march on Saturday in protest over the closure of the hospital.
examples.trans: 她將在週六參加一個反對關閉醫院的示威遊行。

examples.en: a funeral march
examples.trans: 葬禮進行曲

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to walk through a public place as part of a public event to express support for something, or disagreement with or disapproval of something

examples.en: She's going on a march on Saturday in protest over the closure of the hospital.

examples.trans: 有報道說無辜平民受到了殘酷無情的襲擊。

examples.en: There was no shelter from the merciless (= very strong) heat.
examples.trans: 滾滾熱浪襲下人們無處可躲。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: kindness that makes you forgive someone, usually someone that you have authority over

examples.en: She appealed to the judge to have mercy on her husband.
examples.trans: 她請求法官寬恕她的丈夫。

examples.en: The prisoners pleaded for mercy.
examples.trans: 囚犯都懇求從輕發落。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to be in a situation where someone or something has complete power over you
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 任由…的擺布，完全受…的支配

examples.en: She appealed to the judge to have mercy on her husband.
examples.trans: 她請求法官寬恕她的丈夫。

examples.en: The prisoners pleaded for mercy.
examples.trans: 囚犯都懇求從輕發落。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to emphasize that something is not large, important, or effective when compared to something else
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （用於強調不大，不重要或效果不大）僅僅，只，不過

examples.en: I wasn't complaining, I merely said that I was tired.
examples.trans: 我不是抱怨，我只不過是說我累了。

examples.en: I didn't say that you had to go - I merely suggested that you might want to go.
examples.trans: 我不是說你必須去，我只是說你也許會想去。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to emphasize the surprising or strong effect of a very small action or event
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （用於強調某一行動或事件雖小卻有重大影響）僅僅一丁點的，最微小的

examples.en: The merest mention of seafood makes her feel sick.
examples.trans: 只要一提海鮮她就會覺得噁心。

examples.en: The merest hint of criticism makes him defensive.
examples.trans: 只要別人的話裡有一點點批評他的意味，他心中就會充滿防備。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to combine or join together, or to cause things to do this

examples.en: They decided to merge the two companies into one.
examples.trans: 他們決定將兩家公司合併起來。

examples.en: The country's two biggest banks are planning to merge.
examples.trans: 這個國家最大的兩家銀行正計劃合併。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: formal the quality of being good and deserving praise

examples.en: an entertaining film with little artistic merit
examples.trans: 一部有趣但藝術價值不高的電影

examples.en: Her ideas have merit.
examples.trans: 她的想法很有價值。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: informal to spend time doing various things that are not important, without any particular purpose or plan

examples.en: They spend their weekends messing around on their boat.
examples.trans: 他們在船上消磨週末的時光。

examples.en: My brother likes messing around with computers.
examples.trans: 我弟弟喜歡玩電腦打發時間。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to use or treat something in a careless or harmful way

examples.en: I don't want him coming in here and messing around with our computers.
examples.trans: 我不想他到這裡來亂搞我們的電腦。

examples.en: Never mess around with scissors.
examples.trans: 絕對不能玩剪刀。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: an expression, often found in literature, that describes a person or object by referring to something that is considered to have similar characteristics to that person or object

examples.en: "The mind is an ocean" and "the city is a jungle" are both metaphors.
examples.trans: 「思維是海洋」和「城市是叢林」都是隱喻。

examples.en: Metaphor and simile are the most commonly used figures of speech in everyday language.
examples.trans: 隱喻和明喻是日常語言中最常用的修辭手法。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: very careful and with great attention to every detail
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 嚴謹的，一絲不苟的；非常注意細節的

examples.en: Many hours of meticulous preparation have gone into writing the book.
examples.trans: 為寫此書，投入了大量時間細心做前期準備。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: neither high nor low in importance, amount, or size

examples.en: This is my class photo - I'm the one in the middle.
examples.trans: 這是我的全班合照——中間的那個是我。

examples.en: He was standing in the middle of the road.
examples.trans: 他正站在路中央。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to make a suggestion or suggest a possibility in a polite way

examples.en: I brought him some sandwiches because I thought he might be hungry.
examples.trans: 我拿了些三明治給他，因為我想他可能餓了。

examples.en: Very politely the little boy asked if he might have another piece of cake (= he said "May I have another piece of cake, please?").
examples.trans: 小男孩非常禮貌地問可否再吃一塊蛋糕。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: very large, powerful, or important

examples.en: In the next game they will face the mighty Patriots.
examples.trans: 下一場比賽中他們將迎戰實力強大的愛國者隊。

examples.en: the mighty River Po
examples.trans: 滔滔的波河

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: not violent, severe, or extreme

examples.en: She can't accept even mild criticism of her work.
examples.trans: 即使別人對她的作品略有微詞，她也不能接受。

examples.en: He has suffered a mild heart attack - nothing too serious.
examples.trans: 他只是輕微的心臟病發作，並不太嚴重。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the armed forces

examples.en: foreign military intervention
examples.trans: 外國軍事干預

examples.en: The military has opposed any cuts in defence spending.
examples.trans: 軍方反對任何裁減國防開支的舉措。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a period of 1,000 years, or the time when a period of 1,000 years ends
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 一千年，千周年；千周年紀念日

examples.en: The corpse had lain preserved in the soil for almost two millennia.
examples.trans: 那具屍體在地下保存了近兩千年。

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: century

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: UK used when you want to make what you have just said sound less strong
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （用於緩和剛才說過的話）儘管如此，不過嘛，請注意

examples.en: He's very untidy about the house; mind you, I'm not much better.
examples.trans: 他很不注意房子的整潔，不過呢，我也不比他好多少。

examples.en: I know I'm lazy - I did go swimming yesterday, mind.
examples.trans: 我知道我很懶——可我昨天確實去游泳了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to tell someone in a rude way that you do not want them to ask about something private
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 多管閒事，管好你自己的事

examples.en: "Where have you been?" "Mind your own business!"
examples.trans: 「你去哪裡了？」「多管閒事！」

examples.en: See also
examples.trans: myob

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a person who works in a mine

examples.en: a coal miner
examples.trans: 煤礦工

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to mix or combine, or be mixed or combined

examples.en: The excitement of starting a new job is always mingled with a certain apprehension.
examples.trans: 剛開始一份新工作時，興奮中總是摻雜著一點擔憂。

examples.en: The two flavours mingle well.
examples.trans: 兩種味道混合在一起十分搭配。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to move around and talk to other people at a social event

examples.en: The excitement of starting a new job is always mingled with a certain apprehension.
examples.trans: 剛開始一份新工作時，興奮中總是摻雜著一點擔憂。

examples.en: The two flavours mingle well.
examples.trans: 兩種味道混合在一起十分搭配。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to describe something that is a very small copy of an object

examples.en: I bought some miniature furniture for my niece's doll's house.
examples.trans: 我為姪女的玩具屋買了一些模型傢俱模型。

examples.en: The model railway has all the buildings, bridges, and trees in miniature.
examples.trans: 這個鐵路模型包括了所有建築物、橋樑和樹木的縮微景觀。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: smaller than usual

examples.en: I bought some miniature furniture for my niece's doll's house.
examples.trans: 我為姪女的玩具屋買了一些模型傢俱模型。

examples.en: The model railway has all the buildings, bridges, and trees in miniature.
examples.trans: 這個鐵路模型包括了所有建築物、橋樑和樹木的縮微景觀。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: very small in amount

examples.en: There were no injuries and damage to the building was minimal.
examples.trans: 沒有人受傷，建築物的損壞也極小。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to reduce something to the least possible level or amount
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 使降到最低限度；使減到最少

examples.en: We must minimize the risk of infection.
examples.trans: 我們必須將感染的風險降到最低。

examples.en: Environmentalists are doing everything within their power to minimize the impact of the oil spill.
examples.trans: 環保人士正竭盡全力把石油外溢造成的影響減到最少。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the industry or activity of removing substances such as coal or metal from the ground by digging

examples.en: coal/salt mining
examples.trans: 煤／鹽礦業

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: in Britain and some other countries, a department of the government led by a minister

examples.en: the Ministry of Defence/Agriculture
examples.trans: 國防／農業部

examples.en: He practised a preaching and teaching ministry there for over 40 years.
examples.trans: 他在那裡當了40多年的傳教和教學牧師。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: any small group in society that is different from the rest because of their race, religion, or political beliefs, or a person who belongs to such a group
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 少數民族；少數派；少數民族人士；少數派人士

examples.en: It's only a tiny minority of people who are causing the problem.
examples.trans: 惹麻煩的只是極少數的人。

examples.en: Children with single parents at my school were very much in the minority (= there were very few).
examples.trans: 在我的學校裡單親孩子只佔極少數。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: extremely small

examples.en: a 20-minute bus ride
examples.trans: 乘公車20分鐘的車程

examples.en: It takes me 20 minutes to get to work.
examples.trans: 我上班路上要花20分鐘。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to behave badly

examples.en: I was always getting in trouble for misbehaving at school.
examples.trans: 我總是因為在學校裡行為不端而惹上麻煩。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to emphasize the low quality of value of something

examples.en: She's miserable living on her own.
examples.trans: 她獨自生活，非常可憐。

examples.en: What a miserable existence! How could anyone live in such awful conditions?
examples.trans: 多麼痛苦的生活！一個人怎麼能在這麼糟糕的條件下過活？

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: bad luck, or an unlucky event
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 不幸；厄運；不幸事故；災難

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] That was the worst film I've ever had the misfortune to see.
examples.trans: 那是我不走運看過的最糟糕的電影。

examples.en: She suffered a good deal of misfortune over the years.
examples.trans: 多年來她遭受了巨大的不幸。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: bad luck, or an unlucky event or accident

examples.en: The parade was very well organized and passed without mishap.
examples.trans: 遊行隊伍組織得很好，通過時沒有發生意外。

examples.en: A series of mishaps led to the nuclear power plant blowing up.
examples.trans: 一連串不幸事故導致核電廠發生爆炸。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to tell someone information that is not correct

examples.en: I was told she would be at the meeting, but clearly I was misinformed.
examples.trans: 我獲悉她會參加會議，顯然這消息有誤。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to form an understanding that is not correct of something that is said or done

examples.en: My speech has been misinterpreted by the press.
examples.trans: 我的演講被新聞界曲解了。

examples.en: When we re-examined the regulations, we realized that we had misinterpreted them.
examples.trans: 當重新研究章程時，我們意識到以往對之有所誤解。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to cause someone to believe something that is not true
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 誤導；使…產生錯誤的想法；把…引入歧途

examples.en: He has admitted misleading the police about his movements on the night of the murder.
examples.trans: 在謀殺案當晚的行蹤問題上，他承認自己誤導了警方。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to lose something temporarily by forgetting where you have put it
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 隨意擱置；亂放（而一時找不到）

examples.en: She misplaced her keys so often that her secretary used to carry spare ones for her.
examples.trans: 她經常記不起她的鎖匙放在哪裡，因此她的秘書常為她帶著備用鎖匙。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: formal to notice or see

examples.en: The role of scientists is to observe and describe the world, not to try to control it.
examples.trans: 科學家的任務是觀察和描述這個世界，而不是試圖控制它。

examples.en: [ + question word ] He spent a year in the jungle, observing how deforestation is affecting local tribes.
examples.trans: 他在叢林裡住了一年，考察濫伐森林對當地部落造成了何種影響。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a person who watches what happens but has no active part in it

examples.en: observers of the political situation/political observers
examples.trans: 政治觀察家

examples.en: UN observers are monitoring the ceasefire.
examples.trans: 聯合國觀察員在監督此次停火。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: thinking about something or someone, or doing something, too much or all the time
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 著迷的；迷戀的；難以釋懷的

examples.en: He's obsessive about punctuality.
examples.trans: 他過分講究準時。

examples.en: obsessional behaviour
examples.trans: 癡迷的行為

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: not in use any more, having been replaced by something newer and better or more fashionable
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 廢棄的；過時的；淘汰的；老化的

examples.en: Gas lamps became obsolete when electric lighting was invented.
examples.trans: 電燈發明以後煤氣燈就被淘汰了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: something that blocks you so that movement, going forward, or action is prevented or made more difficult

examples.en: The biggest obstacle in our way was a tree trunk in the road.
examples.trans: 我們路上最大的障礙是橫在路上的一棵樹。

examples.en: This decision has removed the last obstacle to the hostages' release.
examples.trans: 這個決定清除了釋放人質的最後障礙。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: sometimes, but not often

examples.en: We met on several occasions to discuss the issue.
examples.trans: 我們幾次會面討論這個問題。

examples.en: I've heard him be rude to her on a number of occasions.
examples.trans: 我有好幾次聽到他對她說話很粗魯。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: not happening or done often or regularly

examples.en: I play the occasional game of tennis.
examples.trans: 我偶爾打打網球。

examples.en: He has the occasional cigar after dinner.
examples.trans: 他飯後偶爾抽支雪茄。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a regular activity or hobby

examples.en: In the space marked "occupation" she wrote "police officer".
examples.trans: 在「職業」一欄裡她寫了「員警」。

examples.en: It seems to me his favourite occupation is eating.
examples.trans: 在我看來，他最喜愛的消遣就是吃。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a situation in which an army or group of people moves into and takes control of a place

examples.en: In the space marked "occupation" she wrote "police officer".
examples.trans: 在「職業」一欄裡她寫了「員警」。

examples.en: It seems to me his favourite occupation is eating.
examples.trans: 在我看來，他最喜愛的消遣就是吃。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: (of an army or group of people) to move into and take control and/or possession of a place

examples.en: The rest of the time was occupied with writing a report.
examples.trans: 剩下的時間用來寫了份報告。

examples.en: The house hasn't been occupied (= lived in) by anyone for a few months.
examples.trans: 這幢房子已經有幾個月沒人住了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: something that happens

examples.en: Street-fights are an everyday occurrence in this area of the city.
examples.trans: 在該市的這一地區，街頭鬥毆每天都會發生。

examples.en: The study compares the occurrence of heart disease in various countries.
examples.trans: 該項研究比較了不同國家心臟病的發病率。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the fact of something existing, or how much of it exists

examples.en: Street-fights are an everyday occurrence in this area of the city.
examples.trans: 在該市的這一地區，街頭鬥毆每天都會發生。

examples.en: The study compares the occurrence of heart disease in various countries.
examples.trans: 該項研究比較了不同國家心臟病的發病率。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: not happening often

examples.en: Her father was an odd man.
examples.trans: 她父親是個古怪的人。

examples.en: What an odd thing to say.
examples.trans: 這樣說太奇怪了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: in a strange or surprising way
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 奇怪地，古怪地；異常地；出人意料地

examples.en: Didn't you think she was behaving very oddly at the party yesterday?
examples.trans: 你難道不覺得她昨天在聚會上表現得很古怪嗎？

examples.en: Oddly enough (= this is strange/surprising), she didn't mention anything about the fact that she was getting married.
examples.trans: 真奇怪，她隻字未提自己要結婚這件事。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the probability (= how likely it is) that a particular thing will or will not happen

examples.en: If you drive a car all your life, the odds are that you'll have an accident at some point.
examples.trans: 如果你一輩子開車的話，你有可能在某一時刻發生車禍。

examples.en: There are heavy odds against people succeeding in such a bad economic climate.
examples.trans: 在如此惡劣的經濟環境下人們成功的可能性很小。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: various things of different types, usually small and not important, or of little value

examples.en: I took most of the big things to the new house, but there are a few odds and ends left to pick up.
examples.trans: 我把大部分大傢什都搬到新房去了，但還有些零碎的東西要收拾。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a smell, often one that is unpleasant

examples.en: Inside the room there was the unmistakable odour of sweaty feet.
examples.trans: 房間裡有一股明顯的臭腳汗味。

examples.en: figurative The odour of hypocrisy hung about everything she said.
examples.trans: 她說的每句話都假惺惺的。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: about; relating to

examples.en: a friend of mine
examples.trans: 我的一位朋友

examples.en: the president of the United States
examples.trans: 美國總統

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: (of an arranged event) stopped or given up
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （安排好的活動）終止的，取消的

examples.en: He drove off at the most incredible speed.
examples.trans: 他以令人難以置信的速度開車走了。

examples.en: Keep the dog on the lead or he'll just run off.
examples.trans: 好好牽著狗，不然它就會跑掉的。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: in a place where few people go, far from any main roads and towns

examples.en: The farmhouse we stayed in was completely off the beaten track.
examples.trans: 我們住的農舍非常偏僻。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If someone says something off the record, they do not want it to be publicly reported.

examples.en: She made it clear that her comments were strictly off the record.
examples.trans: 她說得很清楚，她的這些評論絕不許對外公佈。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If an area of land is off-limits, you are not allowed to enter it.

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: slightly unpleasant or worrying so that you do not want to get involved in any way
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 令人不快的；令人煩惱的，討人厭的

examples.en: He's slightly aggressive, which a lot of people find off-putting when they first meet him.
examples.trans: 他有些好鬥，這讓許多人初次見他時都感覺有些厭惡。

examples.en: What I found off-putting was the amount of work that you were expected to do.
examples.trans: 我覺得煩心的是要讓你幹那麼多的活。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a position of authority and responsibility in a government or other organization

examples.en: the director's office
examples.trans: 主任辦公室

examples.en: I didn't leave the office until eight o'clock last night.
examples.trans: 昨晚我直到8點鐘才離開辦公室。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: relating to a position of responsibility

examples.en: He visited China in his official capacity as America's trade representative.
examples.trans: 他以美方貿易代表的身份訪問了中國。

examples.en: Number Ten Downing Street is the British prime minister's official residence.
examples.trans: 唐寧街10號是英國首相的官邸。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If a piece of information is official, it has been announced publicly with authority.
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 公開的；公佈的；據官方的

examples.en: He visited China in his official capacity as America's trade representative.
examples.trans: 他以美方貿易代表的身份訪問了中國。

examples.en: Number Ten Downing Street is the British prime minister's official residence.
examples.trans: 唐寧街10號是英國首相的官邸。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a person who has a position of responsibility in an organization

examples.en: He visited China in his official capacity as America's trade representative.
examples.trans: 他以美方貿易代表的身份訪問了中國。

examples.en: Number Ten Downing Street is the British prime minister's official residence.
examples.trans: 唐寧街10號是英國首相的官邸。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: formally and in a way agreed to or arranged by people in positions of authority

examples.en: The royal engagement was announced officially this morning.
examples.trans: 今天上午官方正式宣佈了皇室訂婚一事。

examples.en: Well, officially I am on holiday this week, but I'm just catching up on some reports I have to finish.
examples.trans: 這周名義上我是應該休假的，但事實上我還在趕寫幾份報告。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to balance one influence against an opposing influence, so that there is no great difference as a result

examples.en: The extra cost of travelling to work is offset by the lower price of houses here.
examples.trans: 這裡低廉的房價抵消了因上班路途遠而產生的額外費用。

examples.en: UK He keeps his petrol receipts because petrol is one of the expenses that he can offset against tax (= can show to the government as being a business cost, and so not pay tax).
examples.trans: 他保留著他的汽油費收據，因為汽油費是可以抵扣稅款的一項開支。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the young of an animal

examples.en: In the case of the guinea pig, the number of offspring varies between two and five.
examples.trans: 以豚鼠為例，它一胎產2到5個幼仔。

examples.en: Tom's sister came over on Saturday with all her offspring.
examples.trans: 湯姆的姐姐星期六帶著她的一大群子女過來串門。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: humorous or formal a person's children

examples.en: In the case of the guinea pig, the number of offspring varies between two and five.
examples.trans: 以豚鼠為例，它一胎產2到5個幼仔。

examples.en: Tom's sister came over on Saturday with all her offspring.
examples.trans: 湯姆的姐姐星期六帶著她的一大群子女過來串門。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: an area under the earth's surface where there is a large amount of oil

examples.en: the Saudi Arabian oilfields
examples.trans: 沙烏地阿拉伯油田

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to fail to include or do something

examples.en: She was omitted from the list of contributors to the report.
examples.trans: 這篇報道的撰稿人中漏掉了她的名字。

examples.en: The Prince's tour conveniently omitted the most deprived areas of the city.
examples.trans: 親王的巡查為避開麻煩，沒有去該市最貧困的地區。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to show when someone is a member of a group or organization

examples.en: Look at all the books on your desk!
examples.trans: 看看你書桌上這麼多書！

examples.en: Ow, you're standing on my foot!
examples.trans: 哎喲，你踩著我的腳了！

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: used to show when someone has something in a pocket or in a bag that they are carrying

examples.en: Look at all the books on your desk!
examples.trans: 看看你書桌上這麼多書！

examples.en: Ow, you're standing on my foot!
examples.trans: 哎喲，你踩著我的腳了！

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: performing

examples.en: Look at all the books on your desk!
examples.trans: 看看你書桌上這麼多書！

examples.en: Ow, you're standing on my foot!
examples.trans: 哎喲，你踩著我的腳了！

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If something happens on and off during a period of time, it happens sometimes.

examples.en: I've had toothache on and off for a couple of months.
examples.trans: 我的牙斷斷續續疼了幾個月。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: near to someone or something, and ready to help or be used if necessary

examples.en: A 1,200-strong military force will be on hand to monitor the ceasefire.
examples.trans: 將有一支1200人的部隊在現場監督停火。

examples.en: For those of you who don't have an atlas to hand, Newcastle is a city in the northeast of England.
examples.trans: 謹向手上沒有地圖冊的人說明，新堡是英格蘭東北部的一座城市。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If something must on no account/not on any account be done, it must not be done at any time or for any reason.

examples.en: Employees must on no account make personal phone calls from the office.
examples.trans: 員工無論如何不能因為私事使用辦公室電話。

examples.en: These records must not on any account be changed.
examples.trans: 這些紀錄無論如何都不能變動。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 他們不得不得出結論：他們高估了他／他的能力。

examples.trans: 因為下大雨，河水可能會氾濫，漫過河岸。

examples.trans: 今天早上我坐公車時，無意中聽到一段有趣的談話。

examples.trans: 他碰巧聽到女兒對她的毛絨玩具說別那麼淘氣。

examples.en: My musical tastes don't overlap with my brother's at all.
examples.trans: 我對音樂的喜好和我弟弟完全不一樣。

examples.trans: 儘量不要讓你自己工作負擔太重。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to fail to notice or consider something or someone

examples.en: Our hotel room overlooked the harbour.
examples.trans: 從我們飯店的房間可眺望港口。

examples.en: The house is surrounded by trees, so it's not overlooked at all (= it cannot be seen from any other buildings).
examples.trans: 這棟房子四周綠樹環繞，所以從其他建築處根本看不到它。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 在巴黎停留過夜

examples.en: You can stay overnight if you want to.
examples.trans: 要是你願意，可以住一晚。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 我們在美國的銷售額現已超過了我們在歐洲的銷售額。

examples.en: We'd planned to hold a meeting tomorrow, but events have overtaken us (= things have changed).
examples.trans: 我們本打算明天召開一個會議，但情況發生了變化。

examples.trans: 這項工作包括些甚麼內容，我給你作個簡要概括。

examples.trans: 政府軍已擊敗了叛亂者，控制了首都。

examples.en: They were overwhelmed with/by grief when their baby died.
examples.trans: 嬰兒夭折時他們悲痛欲絕。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: doing something dangerous and not worrying about the risks and the possible results
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 魯莽的；輕率的；不顧後果的

examples.en: He was found guilty of reckless driving.
examples.trans: 他被判魯莽駕駛罪名成立。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to feel that something is likely to happen and to make plans that depend upon it happening

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] We're reckoning on selling 2,000 cars a month.
examples.trans: 我們希望每個月的汽車銷售量能達到2000輛。

examples.en: I'm reckoning on your continued support.
examples.trans: 我指望你繼續支持呢。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to deal with a difficult or powerful person or thing
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 處理，解決（棘手的事情）；應付（有權勢的人）

examples.en: If you harm her, you're going to have the police to reckon with.
examples.trans: 你要是傷害了她，就把你送到警察那裡去。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If you are given recognition, people show admiration and respect for your achievements.

examples.en: It's a new country, hoping for diplomatic recognition from the international community.
examples.trans: 這是個新國家，希望在外交上得到國際社會的承認。

examples.en: [ + that ] There's a growing recognition that this country can no longer afford to be a nuclear power.
examples.trans: 越來越多的人認識到，這個國家再也無力充當一個核大國了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the fact of knowing someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

examples.en: It's a new country, hoping for diplomatic recognition from the international community.
examples.trans: 這是個新國家，希望在外交上得到國際社會的承認。

examples.en: [ + that ] There's a growing recognition that this country can no longer afford to be a nuclear power.
examples.trans: 越來越多的人認識到，這個國家再也無力充當一個核大國了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If a person's achievements are recognized, official approval is shown for them.

examples.en: I hadn't seen her for 20 years, but I recognized her immediately.
examples.trans: 我20年沒見她了，但我還是一眼就認出了她。

examples.en: Do you recognize this song?
examples.trans: 「你聽出這首歌來了嗎？」

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to remember something

examples.en: Can you recollect his name?
examples.trans: 你能記起他的名字嗎？

examples.en: As far as I can recollect, his name is Edward.
examples.trans: 我記得他的名字叫愛德華。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: the ability to remember things

examples.en: I have many pleasant recollections of the time we spent together.
examples.trans: 我們一起度過的時光給我留下了許多美好的回憶。

examples.en: His powers of recollection are extraordinary.
examples.trans: 他的記憶力超群。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to find a way in which two situations or beliefs that are opposed to each other can agree and exist together

examples.en: It is sometimes difficult to reconcile science and religion.
examples.trans: 有時很難調和宗教和科學之間的矛盾。

examples.en: It's difficult to reconcile such different points of view.
examples.trans: 差別如此懸殊的觀點是很難達成一致的。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to accept a situation or fact although you do not like it
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 與…達成妥協；使甘心於；使順從於

examples.en: She must reconcile herself to the fact that she must do some work if she wants to pass her exams.
examples.trans: 她必須接受這樣一個事實： 要想通過考試，就必須下點工夫學習。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to think again about a decision or opinion and decide if you want to change it

examples.en: He begged her to reconsider but she would not.
examples.trans: 他求她重新考慮，可她不願意。

examples.en: We have reconsidered your proposals and we have decided to go ahead with the deal.
examples.trans: 我們已經重新考慮了你的建議，決定繼續這筆交易。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to build or create again something that has been damaged or destroyed
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 重建，改建，重造（被毀的事物）

examples.en: The post-war government had the enormous task of reconstructing the city.
examples.trans: 戰後的政府擔負著重建該城市的艱巨任務。

examples.en: They were given the task of reconstructing the city's public transport system.
examples.trans: 重建該市公交系統的任務交給了他們。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If you reconstruct something that has happened in the past, you combine a lot of information in order to get a complete description of what happened.
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （根據許多資料對發生的事情）重現描述，使重現，使再現

examples.en: The post-war government had the enormous task of reconstructing the city.
examples.trans: 戰後的政府擔負著重建該城市的艱巨任務。

examples.en: They were given the task of reconstructing the city's public transport system.
examples.trans: 重建該市公交系統的任務交給了他們。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: an attempt to get a complete description of an event using the information available, or an attempt to repeat what happened during the event
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （根據掌握的資料對發生的事情進行的）重現描述，重現，再現

examples.en: Post-war economic reconstruction in the country must begin with the resumption of agricultural production.
examples.trans: 這個國家戰後經濟的重建必須從恢復農業生産開始。

examples.en: A dramatized reconstruction of the robbery was shown on television to try to make people remember information that would help the police.
examples.trans: 這宗搶劫案以電視劇的形式再現並在電視上播出，是為了使人們能夠記起任何有關案件的重要情況，來幫助員警破案。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to make something exist or happen again

examples.en: They plan to recreate a typical English village in Japan.
examples.trans: 他們計劃在日本再現一個典型的英國式村莊。

examples.en: Their work involves restoring and recreating wildlife habitats all across the country.
examples.trans: 他們的工作包括在全國恢復和重建野生動植物的生長環境。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a new member of an organization, especially the army
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 新成員，新來的人；（尤指）新兵

examples.en: Charities such as Oxfam are always trying to recruit volunteers to help in their work.
examples.trans: 諸如樂施會這樣的慈善組織總是在盡力吸收志願者來幫助他們工作。

examples.en: Even young boys are now being recruited into the army.
examples.trans: 就連很年輕的男生都被徵召入伍了。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a flat shape with four 90° angles and four sides, with opposite sides of equal length

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: formal to correct something or make something right

examples.en: I am determined to take whatever action is necessary to rectify the situation.
examples.trans: 我決心採取一切必要的措施來整頓局面。

examples.en: Every effort is made to rectify any errors/mistakes before the book is printed.
examples.trans: 在書付印前會盡力去審校修改書中的錯誤。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to happen many times or to happen again
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 反復出現；再次發生；重新産生

examples.en: The theme of freedom recurs throughout her writing.
examples.trans: 自由這一主題在她的寫作中反復出現。

examples.en: If the pain/problem/trouble, etc. recurs, come and see me.
examples.trans: 如果疼痛復發／問題再出現／再感不適等，就來找我。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: official rules and processes that seem unnecessary and delay results
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 繁文縟節；官僚作風；拖拉費時的繁瑣手續

examples.en: We must cut through the red tape.
examples.trans: 我們必須要克服官僚文牘主義。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to change an area of a town by replacing old buildings, roads, etc. with new ones

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to share something out differently from before, especially in a fairer way
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （尤指更加公平地）重新分配，再分發，重新分派

examples.en: As president he would redistribute the country's wealth.
examples.trans: 作為總統，他將重新分配國家財富。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to make someone unhappy or cause someone to be in a bad state or situation
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 使（某人）（情緒）低落；使（某人）淪落，使（某人）陷入困境

examples.en: His comments reduced her to tears (= made her cry).
examples.trans: 他的話把她氣哭了。

examples.en: The sergeant was reduced to the ranks (= made an ordinary soldier) for his cowardice.
examples.trans: 中士因為貪生怕死被降爲士兵。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If you are reduced to doing something, you are forced to do it because you have no other choice.
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 使（某人）被逼無奈做…；使（某人）不得不做…

examples.en: His comments reduced her to tears (= made her cry).
examples.trans: 他的話把她氣哭了。

examples.en: The sergeant was reduced to the ranks (= made an ordinary soldier) for his cowardice.
examples.trans: 中士因為貪生怕死被降爲士兵。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: UK a situation in which someone loses their job because their employer does not need them

examples.en: The economic downturn has meant 10,000 redundancies in the Northeast.
examples.trans: 由於經濟衰退，東北地區有一萬人失業。

examples.en: She took voluntary redundancy.
examples.trans: 她選擇了自願裁汰。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: (especially of a word, phrase, etc.) unnecessary because it is more than is needed
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （尤指詞、片語等）多餘的，不需要的，累贅的，囉唆的

examples.en: In the sentence "She is a single unmarried woman", the word "unmarried" is redundant.
examples.trans: 在句子 She is a single unmarried woman 中，unmarried 一詞是多餘的。

examples.en: To keep the company alive, half the workforce is being made redundant.
examples.trans: 為了使公司生存下去，一半的僱員要被裁掉。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to look at, or tell someone else to look at, a book or similar record in order to find information and help

examples.en: She spoke for an hour without once referring to her notes.
examples.trans: 她講了一個小時，沒有看過一眼講稿。

examples.en: He referred to a history book to find out the dates of the French Revolution.
examples.trans: 他查閱歷史書來弄清法國大革命的日期。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to direct someone or something to a different place or person for information, help, or action, often to a person or group with more knowledge or power
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 讓（某人）求助於；讓（某人）向…查詢；將（某人）送交給

examples.en: My doctor referred me to a hospital specialist.
examples.trans: 我的醫生把我轉診給一位醫院的專家。

examples.en: The High Court has referred the case to the Court of Appeal.
examples.trans: 高級法院已將此案呈交上訴法院。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: If writing or information refers to someone or something, it relates to that person or thing

examples.en: In her autobiography she occasionally refers to her unhappy schooldays.
examples.trans: 在其自傳中，她偶爾提及了她不快樂的學生時代。

examples.en: The new salary scale only refers to company managers and directors.
examples.trans: 新的工資級別標準只適用於公司經理和主管人員。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a quick look at a book, piece of paper, etc. in order to find information and help

examples.en: Knowing what had happened, I avoided making any reference to (= mentioning) weddings.
examples.trans: 因為我知道發生了甚麽，所以就避開不談婚禮的事情。

examples.en: formal I am writing with/in reference to (= in connection with) your letter of 15 March.
examples.trans: 現就3月15日貴函致覆。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a vote in which all the people in a country or an area are asked to give their opinion about or decide an important political or social question
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: （就重大政治或社會問題進行的）全民公決，全民公投

examples.en: Is it more democratic to hold a referendum, rather than let the government alone decide?
examples.trans: 進行一次全民公決，而不是由政府自己作出決定，是不是要更民主些？

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: to improve an idea, method, system, etc. by making small changes

examples.en: Crude oil is industrially refined to purify it and separate out the different elements, such as benzene.
examples.trans: 原油經過工業提煉來提純並且分離出諸如苯之類的不同元素。

examples.en: Engineers spent many months refining the software.
examples.trans: 工程師們花了數月來完善這個軟體。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: improved because of many small changes that have been made

examples.en: highly refined theories
examples.trans: 非常精煉的理論

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: very polite and showing knowledge of social rules
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.translation: 有教養的；文雅的；優雅的

examples.en: highly refined theories
examples.trans: 非常精煉的理論

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: a sign or result of something

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Narcissus fell in love with his own reflection in a pool of water.
examples.trans: 希臘神話中的那喀索斯愛上了自己在水池中的倒影。

examples.en: He put silver foil around the fire to increase heat reflection.
examples.trans: 他用銀箔圍住火爐來增加熱的反射。

Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic &.definition_en: formal serious and careful thought

examples.en: In Greek mythology, Narcissus fell in love with his own reflection in a pool of water.

examples.trans: 我們正在研究大象的繁殖問題。
