examples.trans: 水正從管子裡漏出來。

examples.en: Oil leaked out of the car.
examples.trans: 油從車裡漏了出來。

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: a printed or electronic document containing information about the recent activities of an organization, sent regularly to the organization's members
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.translation: （機構定期寄發給成員的）通訊，簡報

examples.en: a monthly newsletter
examples.trans: 每月簡報

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: a person whose job is to produce computer programs
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.translation: （電腦的）程式編制員，程式設計師

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: a memory of something

examples.en: I have many pleasant recollections of the time we spent together.
examples.trans: 我們一起度過的時光給我留下了許多美好的回憶。

examples.en: His powers of recollection are extraordinary.
examples.trans: 他的記憶力超群。

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: If a device records a measurement, it shows that measurement.

examples.en: Cliff Richard has recorded more number one hit songs than any other British pop star.
examples.trans: 在英國流行樂歌星中，克利夫．理查錄製的歌曲榮登排行榜榜首的數量最多。

examples.en: We recorded their wedding on video.
examples.trans: 我們給他們的婚禮錄了像。

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: to use a machine to put a picture of a document into a computer, or to take a picture of the inside of something
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.translation: 掃瞄（使用機器，將某一檔的圖片輸入到電腦中，或拍攝某物內部的圖片）

examples.en: She anxiously scanned the faces of the men leaving the train.
examples.trans: 她急切地盯著一張張走下火車的人的臉。

examples.en: Doug scanned the horizon for any sign of the boat.
examples.trans: 道格注視著海平面，搜尋著那隻船。

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: to move text or other information on a computer screen in order to see a different part of it

examples.en: The ancient Egyptians stored information on scrolls.
examples.trans: 古埃及人把資訊記載在捲軸上。

examples.en: The tops of the marble pillars were decorated with scrolls.
examples.trans: 大理石柱子的頂端有渦捲形裝飾。

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: a device for making a loud warning noise

examples.en: police sirens
examples.trans: 警笛

examples.en: When the air raid siren went off people ran to their shelters.
examples.trans: 空襲警報響起時，人們紛紛跑向掩蔽所。

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: fast electronic dance music with a regular beat
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.translation: 高技術音樂（一種節奏快而強勁的電子舞蹈音樂）

examples.en: Thousands of ravers came to Berlin yesterday for the world's largest techno music party.
examples.trans: 幾千名銳舞客昨天來到柏林，參加全球最大型的電子舞曲音樂派對。

examples.en: a technophile (= a person who loves technology)
examples.trans: 科技愛好者

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: a connected group of pieces of writing on the internet, where people are talking about a particular subject

examples.en: needle and thread
examples.trans: 針線

examples.en: loose threads
examples.trans: 鬆散的線

Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.domain: Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử (IT, Computing & Electronics)
Công nghệ thông tin, Máy tính & Điện tử.definition_en: to follow a person or animal by looking for proof that they have been somewhere, or by using electronic equipment

examples.en: a ten-mile stretch of track
examples.trans: 十英里長的鐵軌

examples.en: Passengers are requested not to walk across the tracks.
examples.trans: 乘客不得穿越鐵軌。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: specialized environment very dry and without enough rain for plants

examples.en: The desert is so arid that nothing can grow there.
examples.trans: 沙漠中極其乾旱，寸草不生。

examples.en: After several arid years, the company has started to become successful.
examples.trans: 經過了幾個不景氣的年頭後，公司已經開始走向成功發展之路。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: the general development of a situation, or the situation, feelings, and opinions that exist at a particular time
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: 形勢，趨勢；（某一時期的）風尚，風氣，思潮

examples.en: a hot/dry/harsh climate
examples.trans: 炎熱／乾燥／惡劣的氣候

examples.en: The Mediterranean climate is good for growing citrus fruits and grapes.
examples.trans: 地中海氣候適宜柑橘屬水果和葡萄的生長。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: carefully using valuable natural substances that exist in limited amounts in order to make certain that they will be available for as long a time as possible
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: （對自然資源等的）保護，保存，節約

examples.en: wildlife conservation
examples.trans: 野生生物保育

examples.en: a conservation area
examples.trans: 保育區

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: to prepare land and grow crops on it, or to grow a particular crop

examples.en: Most of the land there is too poor to cultivate.
examples.trans: 那裡大部分土地太貧瘠，無法耕種。

examples.en: The villagers cultivate mostly maize and beans.
examples.trans: 村民們主要種植玉米和豆類。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: the relationships between the air, land, water, animals, plants, etc., usually of a particular area, or the scientific study of this
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: （通常指一個特定區域的）生態；生態學

examples.en: The oil spill caused terrible damage to the fragile ecology of the coast.
examples.trans: 石油外泄給脆弱的海岸生態環境帶來嚴重的破壞。

examples.en: She hopes to study ecology at college.
examples.trans: 她希望在大學裡讀生態學。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: a person who is interested in or studies the environment and who tries to protect it from being damaged by human activities
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: 環境保護主義者；環境保護論者

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: the fact of soil, stone, etc. being gradually damaged and removed by the waves, rain, or wind

examples.en: soil/coastal erosion
examples.trans: 水土流失/海岸侵蝕

examples.en: The survey reveals a gradual erosion of the president's popularity and support.
examples.trans: 民意調查顯示了總統聲望和所獲支持的逐漸削弱。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: the natural environment in which an animal or plant usually lives

examples.en: With so many areas of woodland being cut down, a lot of wildlife is losing its natural habitat.
examples.trans: 大片林地被砍伐，很多野生動物在失去牠們的天然棲息地。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: to be unable to travel away from a place because of very heavy snow

examples.en: Outside the snow began to fall.
examples.trans: 外面開始下雪了。

examples.en: Let's go and play in the snow!
examples.trans: 我們一起去玩雪吧！

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: causing little or no damage to the environment and therefore able to continue for a long time
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: （對環境沒有損害或損害很小因而）可持續的，能長期維持的

examples.en: That sort of extreme diet is not sustainable over a long period.
examples.trans: 那種極端的飲食方式無法長期堅持。

examples.en: A large international meeting was held with the aim of promoting sustainable development in all countries.
examples.trans: 召開了一個旨在促進所有國家永續發展的大型國際會議。

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: An undeveloped place or piece of land has not been built on or used for farming.
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: （地方或土地）未開發的；未耕種的

Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.domain: Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Ecology, Environment & Agriculture)
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.definition_en: causing damage to the environment by using more of something than can be replaced naturally
Môi trường, Sinh thái & Nông nghiệp (Eco.translation: 枯竭式開採資源的；不符合可持續發展的；不可持續的

examples.en: This level of spending is unsustainable.
examples.trans: 這種開銷持續不了多久。

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a thick covering of something

examples.en: The ground was covered by a thick blanket of snow.
examples.trans: 地上覆蓋著一層厚厚的雪。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lớp

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: someone or something that is new and different and makes everything seem more exciting
all_entries.translation: 令人耳目一新的人（或物）

examples.en: Angela's so cheerful and lively - she's like a breath of fresh air when she visits.
examples.trans: 安琪拉如此快樂，充滿活力——她一來就像帶來了一陣清新的空氣。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một sự thay đổi thú vị / một làn gió mới / sảng khoái
all_entries.translation_zh: 令人耳目一新的人（或物）

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: someone who is extremely nervous and worried
all_entries.translation: 焦躁的人；緊張不安的人

examples.en: Sorry for shouting - I'm a bundle of nerves these days.
examples.trans: 很抱歉對你大叫大嚷——這些天我很焦躁。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không yên / bất ổn / bất an / rối bời / bồn chồn / lo lắng
all_entries.translation_zh: 焦躁的人；緊張不安的人

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a situation in which someone cannot make a fair decision because they will be affected by the result
all_entries.translation: 利益（或利害）衝突（因為相關自身利益而使當事人無法做出公正或公平判斷的情況）

examples.en: I need to declare a conflict of interest here - one of the candidates for the job is a friend of mine.
examples.trans: 我需要報告一個利益衝突的情況——這份工作的候選人之一是我的朋友。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lợi ích riêng
all_entries.translation_zh: 利益（或利害）衝突（因為相關自身利益而使當事人無法做出公正或公平判斷的情況）

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a very small amount compared to the amount needed

examples.en: My letter of protest was just a drop in the ocean.
examples.trans: 我的抗議書不過是杯水車薪。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: một cốc nước dập lửa cỗ xe củi cháy (thành ngữ); nghĩa bóng: biện pháp hoàn toàn không đủ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If you say that there is a fine line between one thing and another, you mean that they are very similar. You often say this when one thing is acceptable and the other is not.

examples.en: As a parent, I knew that there was a fine line between panic and caution.
examples.trans: 作為家長，我知道驚慌和謹慎有所不同。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khác biệt ở một mức độ nào đó (thành ngữ)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: something that you do because it will help you to achieve something else

examples.en: I didn't particularly like the job - it was just a means to an end.
examples.trans: 我不是特別喜歡這項工作——不過是一個謀生手段罷了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phương pháp; cách thức; phương tiện (làm gì đó) / kỹ năng; khả năng / mánh khoé; thủ đoạn

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: extremely colourful and bright

examples.en: Jim's rose garden is a riot of colour.
examples.trans: 吉姆的玫瑰園五彩繽紛。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rực rỡ và nhiều màu sắc / lộng lẫy

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a place to live

examples.en: She gave him enough money to get a roof over his head.
examples.trans: 她給他的錢足夠他找個住處了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nơi cư trú; chỗ ở

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a difficult time

examples.en: Government plans to cut sick pay had a rough ride in the House of Commons.
examples.trans: 政府削減病假工資的計劃受到了下議院的阻撓。

examples.en: The construction industry is in for a rough ride this year.
examples.trans: 建築業今年困難重重。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giai đoạn / pha

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: someone who is willing to listen to your problems and give you sympathy, emotional support, and encouragement
all_entries.translation: 可以傾訴的對象，可以向其尋求安慰的人

examples.en: I wish you'd been here when my mother died and I needed a shoulder to cry on.
examples.trans: 我母親去世的時候，你要是在這裡就好了，我當時需要一個可以給我安慰的人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nói ra hết (những gì trong lòng)
all_entries.translation_zh: 可以傾訴的對象，可以向其尋求安慰的人

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a very short distance

examples.en: The apartment is just a stone's throw from the sea.
examples.trans: 公寓離海非常近。

examples.en: "Is your house far from here?" "No, it's only a stone's throw away."
examples.trans: 「你的房子離這裡遠嗎？」「不遠，幾步路就到了。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: khoảng cách

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: something that is certain to happen

examples.en: The president's re-election is now far from a sure thing.
examples.trans: 總統能否再次當選還遠不能確定。

all_entries.meaning_vi: xảy ra; xảy đến; diễn ra; bùng phát

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to stop doing an activity before you have finished it

examples.en: We had to abandon the car.
examples.trans: 我們不得不棄車而去。

examples.en: By the time the rebel troops arrived, the village had already been abandoned.
examples.trans: 當叛軍殺到時，村民已經撤離了村莊。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bỏ, bỏ rơi (đ)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: intelligent or good at what you do

examples.en: Will she be able to cope with the work?
examples.trans: 她能應付這項工作嗎？

examples.en: He's never been able to admit to his mistakes.
examples.trans: 他從來無法承認自己的錯誤。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có năng lực, có tài; có đủ tư cách, có đủ thẩm quyền

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: different from what is usual or average, especially in a way that is bad
all_entries.translation: 反常的；異常的；變態的（尤指不好的）

examples.en: Tests revealed some abnormal skin cells.
examples.trans: 檢驗結果顯示一些皮膚細胞異常。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất thường; (thống kê) không chuẩn
all_entries.translation_zh: 反常的；異常的；變態的（尤指不好的）

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: on or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train
all_entries.translation: 上船（或飛機、公共汽車、火車等）；在船（或飛機、公共汽車、火車等）上

examples.en: The flight attendant welcomed us aboard.
examples.trans: 空服員迎候我們登機。

examples.en: Welcome aboard flight BA345 to Tokyo.
examples.trans: 歡迎乘坐BA345航班飛往東京。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trên tàu, trên boong tàu, trên thuyền, trên xe lửa; trên máy bay; dọc theo; gần, kế; lên trên (tàu thuỷ, xe lửa, máy bay...)
all_entries.translation_zh: 上船（或飛機、公共汽車、火車等）；在船（或飛機、公共汽車、火車等）上

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the intentional ending of a pregnancy
all_entries.translation: （通常指透過手術進行的）墮胎，人工流產

examples.en: She decided to have/get an abortion.
examples.trans: 她決定接受人工流產。

examples.en: Abortion is restricted in some American states.
examples.trans: 美國一些州禁止墮胎。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự sẩy thai, sự phá thai; sự nạo thai; người lùn tịt; đứa bé đẻ non, vật đẻ non; vật dị dạng, quái thai; sự chết non chết yểu, sự sớm thất bại (của một kế hoạch, ý đồ...)
all_entries.translation_zh: （通常指透過手術進行的）墮胎，人工流產

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: too good or important for something

examples.en: There's a mirror above the sink.
examples.trans: 洗碗槽上方有面鏡子。

examples.en: He waved the letter excitedly above his head.
examples.trans: 他興奮地把信舉過頭頂揮舞著。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ở trên, cao hơn

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: sudden and unexpected, and often unpleasant

examples.en: an abrupt change/movement
examples.trans: 突變／突發情況

examples.en: Our conversation came to an abrupt end when George burst into the room.
examples.trans: 喬治突然衝進房間裡，我們的談話戛然而止。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất ngờ, đột ngột; vội vã; cộc lốc, lấc cấc, thô lỗ; dốc đứng, hiểm trở, gian nan

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: using too few words when talking, in a way that seems rude and unfriendly

examples.en: an abrupt change/movement
examples.trans: 突變／突發情況

examples.en: Our conversation came to an abrupt end when George burst into the room.
examples.trans: 喬治突然衝進房間裡，我們的談話戛然而止。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất ngờ, đột ngột; vội vã; cộc lốc, lấc cấc, thô lỗ; dốc đứng, hiểm trở, gian nan

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used as a strong way of saying "no"
all_entries.translation: （表示強烈反對）當然不是，絕對不行

examples.en: I believed/trusted him absolutely.
examples.trans: 我絕對相信／信任他。

examples.en: You must be absolutely silent or the birds won't appear.
examples.trans: 你必須絕對安靜，不然鳥兒就不會飛出來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một cách tuyệt đối
all_entries.translation_zh: （表示強烈反對）當然不是，絕對不行

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to understand facts or ideas completely and remember them

examples.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide.
examples.trans: 植物吸收二氧化碳。

examples.en: In cold climates, houses need to have walls that will absorb heat.
examples.trans: 在氣候寒冷的地方，房屋的牆壁必須能吸收熱量。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hấp thu, hút thu

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: rude and offensive words said to another person

examples.en: She is continually abusing her position/authority by getting other people to do things for her.
examples.trans: 她不斷濫用職權／權力，讓別人替她做事。

examples.en: I never expected that he would abuse the trust I placed in him.
examples.trans: 我從未料到他會利用我對他的信任。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự lạm dụng, sự lộng hành; thói xấu, hủ tục; sự lăng mạ, sự sỉ nhục, sự chửi rủa, sự xỉ vả

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: using rude and offensive words

examples.en: an abusive letter/phone call
examples.trans: 辱駡信／電話

examples.en: He was apparently abusive to the flight attendants.
examples.trans: 顯然他對航班空服員說了些不乾不淨的話。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lạm dụng; lăng mạ, sỉ nhục, chửi rủa; lừa dối, lừa gạt

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used to describe someone who is clever and enjoys studying

examples.en: an academic institution
examples.trans: 學術機構

examples.en: the academic year (= the time during which students go to school or college)
examples.trans: 學年

all_entries.meaning_vi: học viện; (thuộc) trường đại học; viện hàn lâm; có tính chất học thuật

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: When a vehicle or its driver accelerates, the speed of the vehicle increases.

examples.en: I accelerated to overtake the bus.
examples.trans: 我加速超過了公車。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: decelerate

all_entries.meaning_vi: tăng tốc, gia tốc, làm nhanh

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If a person or object accelerates, he, she, or it goes faster.

examples.en: I accelerated to overtake the bus.
examples.trans: 我加速超過了公車。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: decelerate

all_entries.meaning_vi: tăng tốc, gia tốc, làm nhanh

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to happen or make something happen sooner or faster
all_entries.translation: （使）加快，（使）增速；促進；提前，（促使）早日發生

examples.en: I accelerated to overtake the bus.
examples.trans: 我加速超過了公車。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: decelerate

all_entries.meaning_vi: tăng tốc, gia tốc, làm nhanh
all_entries.translation_zh: （使）加快，（使）增速；促進；提前，（促使）早日發生

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the act of agreeing to an offer, plan, or invitation

examples.en: The idea rapidly gained acceptance (= became approved of) in political circles.
examples.trans: 這個想法很快就得到了政界的認同。

examples.en: The party marked his acceptance into the community.
examples.trans: 這次聚會意味著社團已接納他為成員。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự nhận, sự thu nhận

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: generally agreed to be satisfactory or right

examples.en: "Speed bump" now seems to be the generally accepted term for those ridges in the road that slow traffic down.
examples.trans: 為了使車輛放慢速度而鋪設在路上的隆起物，現在似乎有個公認的名稱，叫做「減速帶」。

all_entries.meaning_vi: được công nhận, được thừa nhận

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: easy to understand

examples.en: The resort is easily accessible by road, rail, and air.
examples.trans: 這個旅遊勝地交通便利，坐汽車、火車和飛機都可以到達。

examples.en: The problem with some of these drugs is that they are so very accessible.
examples.trans: 此類毒品的問題在於當中一些很容易獲取。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tới được, đạt được

all_entries.domain: Kỹ thuật công nghiệp, Cơ khí & Xây dựng (Engineering, Mechanics & Industry)
all_entries.definition_en: something added to a machine or to clothing that has a useful or decorative purpose
all_entries.translation: 附件，配件，附屬品；裝飾品，配飾

examples.en: She wore a green wool suit with matching accessories (= shoes, hat, bag, etc.).
examples.trans: 她身著綠色羊毛套裝，全身的配飾都與之配套。

examples.en: Sunglasses are much more than a fashion accessory.
examples.trans: 太陽鏡不僅僅是時尚的裝飾品。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đồ phụ tùng; vật phụ thuộc; đồ thêm vào; kẻ tòng phạm, kẻ a tòng, kẻ đồng loã; phụ, phụ vào, thêm vào
all_entries.translation_zh: 附件，配件，附屬品；裝飾品，配飾

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to sing or play an instrument with another musician or singer

examples.en: The course books are accompanied by four CDs.
examples.trans: 這些課本配有四張光碟。

examples.en: Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.
examples.trans: 憂鬱症幾乎總是和失眠分不開。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đi theo, đi cùng, đi kèm, hộ tống; phụ thêm, kèm theo; đệm (đàn, nhạc)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to finish something successfully or to achieve something

examples.en: The students accomplished the task in less than ten minutes.
examples.trans: 學生不到十分鐘就完成了任務。

examples.en: She accomplished such a lot during her visit.
examples.trans: 她在訪問期間取得了豐碩的成果。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hoàn thành, làm xong, làm trọn; thực hiện, đạt tới (mục đích...); làm (ai) hoàn hảo, làm (ai) đạt tới sự hoàn mỹ (về nhạc, hoạ, nữ công...)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If you do something of your own accord, you do it without being asked to do it.

examples.en: On 31 May the two leaders signed a peace accord.
examples.trans: 5月31日兩位領導人簽署了一項和平協議。

examples.en: Before 1987, the accord between the Labour government and the unions was a simple affair.
examples.trans: 1987年以前，工黨政府和工會之間很容易達成一致。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự đồng lòng, sự đồng ý, sự tán thành; hoà ước; sự phù hợp, sự hoà hợp

all_entries.domain: Luật pháp, Tư pháp & Chính sách (Law, Legal & Governance)
all_entries.definition_en: following or obeying a rule, law, wish, etc.

examples.en: In accordance with her wishes, she was buried in France.
examples.trans: 按照她的遺願，人們將她安葬在法國。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự đồng ý, sự thoả thuận (với ai); sự phù hợp, sự theo đúng (cái gì); sự cho, sự ban cho

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: as said by most people
all_entries.translation: 根據各方面所說；據說；大家都說

examples.en: I've opened an account with a building society.
examples.trans: 我在房屋互助協會開了個帳戶。

examples.en: I paid the money into my account this morning.
examples.trans: 今天上午我把錢存入了我的帳戶。

all_entries.meaning_vi: kể đến, tính đến
all_entries.translation_zh: 根據各方面所說；據說；大家都說

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to explain the reason for something or the cause of something
all_entries.translation: （對某人）就…作出解釋；（對某人）就…作出說明

examples.en: Can you account for your absence last Friday?
examples.trans: 你能解釋一下上週五你為甚麼缺勤嗎？

examples.en: She was unable to account for over $5,000 (= she could not explain where the money was).
examples.trans: 她無法對5000多美元的去向作出解釋。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đưa ra / nghĩ ra / thực hiện (lựa chọn, quyết định, đề xuất, phản hồi, bình luận v.v.) / ban hành (giấy phép, tuyên bố, giải thích, xin lỗi, trấn an công chúng v.v.) / rút ra (kết luận) / đưa ra (bài phát biểu, phán quyết) / nghĩ ra (giải thích) / trích xuất
all_entries.translation_zh: （對某人）就…作出解釋；（對某人）就…作出說明

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: Someone who is accountable is completely responsible for what they do and must be able to give a satisfactory reason for it.
all_entries.translation: 應負責任的；應作解釋的；應加以說明的

examples.en: She is accountable only to the managing director.
examples.trans: 她只對總裁負責。

examples.en: The recent tax reforms have made government more accountable for its spending.
examples.trans: 最近的稅務改革使政府的開支更加透明化。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chịu trách nhiệm, có trách nhiệm phải giải thích; có thể nói rõ được, có thể giải thích được
all_entries.translation_zh: 應負責任的；應作解釋的；應加以說明的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to collect a large number of things over a long period of time

examples.en: As people accumulate more wealth, they tend to spend a greater proportion of their incomes.
examples.trans: 人們積累了更多財富後，他們的花費佔收入的比重也往往會增加。

examples.en: The company said the debt was accumulated during its acquisition of nine individual businesses.
examples.trans: 該公司稱其在收購九家個體公司的過程中，債務越積越多。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tích luỹ, tụ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to gradually increase in number or amount

examples.en: As people accumulate more wealth, they tend to spend a greater proportion of their incomes.
examples.trans: 人們積累了更多財富後，他們的花費佔收入的比重也往往會增加。

examples.en: The company said the debt was accumulated during its acquisition of nine individual businesses.
examples.trans: 該公司稱其在收購九家個體公司的過程中，債務越積越多。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tích luỹ, tụ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: an amount of something that has been collected

examples.en: Despite this accumulation of evidence, the government persisted in doing nothing.
examples.trans: 儘管種種跡象不斷出現，政府仍然堅持不採取任何行動。

examples.en: Accumulations of sand can be formed by the action of waves on coastal beaches.
examples.trans: 由於海浪的衝擊作用，海灘上會堆積沙子。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự tích luỹ; sự tụ, điểm tụ

all_entries.domain: Luật pháp, Tư pháp & Chính sách (Law, Legal & Governance)
all_entries.definition_en: a statement saying that someone has done something morally wrong, illegal, or unkind, or the fact of accusing someone

examples.en: You can't just make wild accusations like that!
examples.trans: 你不能那樣胡亂指責人！

examples.en: He glared at me with an air of accusation.
examples.trans: 他瞪著我，一臉責備的樣子。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự kết tội, sự buộc tội; sự bị kết tội; sự tố cáo; cáo trạng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: familiar with something

examples.en: She quickly became accustomed to his messy ways.
examples.trans: 她很快就習慣了他的邋遢作風。

examples.en: I'm not accustomed to being treated like this.
examples.trans: 我不習慣別人這樣待我。

all_entries.meaning_vi: quen với; thành thói quen, thành thường lệ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to accept, admit, or recognize something, or the truth or existence of something

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] She acknowledged having been at fault.
examples.trans: 她承認自己有過錯。

examples.en: [ + that ] She acknowledged that she had been at fault.
examples.trans: 她承認自己有過錯。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhận, thừa nhận, công nhận; báo cho biết đã nhận được; đền đáp; tỏ lòng biết ơn, cảm tạ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to tell someone, usually in a letter or email, that you have received something they sent you
all_entries.translation: （通過信函或電子郵件等）確認收悉

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] She acknowledged having been at fault.
examples.trans: 她承認自己有過錯。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khác nhau một trời một vực (thành ngữ) / khác nhau hoàn toàn

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be unable to stop watching something
all_entries.translation: 全神貫注地盯著…看，目不轉睛地看

examples.en: We were glued to the television watching the election results come in.
examples.trans: 我們目不轉睛地盯著電視，等待大選結果揭曉。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tập trung toàn bộ sự chú ý (thành ngữ) / chú ý hoàn toàn
all_entries.translation_zh: 全神貫注地盯著…看，目不轉睛地看

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to continue to exist and be successful or work well, after a long period
all_entries.translation: 活躍依舊；長盛不衰；依然運行良好

examples.en: After fifty years, the town's theatre is still going strong.
examples.trans: 五十年後，鎮上的劇院依舊在正常營運。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không suy yếu / không bao giờ suy tàn / bền bỉ / không thể ngăn chặn
all_entries.translation_zh: 活躍依舊；長盛不衰；依然運行良好

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be very unhappy because someone has something that you want
all_entries.translation: 十分妒忌，非常嫉妒，眼紅

examples.en: Chad is heading off to Spain for the week, and I'm green with envy.
examples.trans: 查德要到西班牙逗留一星期，真令我眼紅。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rất / hoàn toàn / cực kỳ / vô cùng / tuyệt đối / một trăm phần trăm / chia thành mười phần bằng nhau
all_entries.translation_zh: 十分妒忌，非常嫉妒，眼紅

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be worried and not relaxed

examples.en: He seemed ill at ease and not his usual self.
examples.trans: 他似乎不大自在，不像平時的他。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất an / không thoải mái

all_entries.word: be in a tight corner spot
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be in a difficult situation
all_entries.translation: 被逼到角落裡；身處困境
all_entries.meaning_vi: tình cảnh khó khăn; hoàn cảnh khó khăn
all_entries.translation_zh: 被逼到角落裡；身處困境

all_entries.word: be in bad poor the worst possible etc taste
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be unacceptable in a way that will upset or anger people

examples.en: He told a joke about death that I thought was in poor taste considering that Steve's father had just died.
examples.trans: 他講了一個關於死亡的笑話，我覺得很不得體，因為史蒂夫的父親剛去世不久。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không được / không thể / không được phép

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be going to experience something unpleasant very soon

examples.en: The weather forecast says we're in for heavy rain this evening.
examples.trans: 天氣報告說，這邊今晚將有大雨。

examples.en: You'll be in for it (= you'll be in trouble) if you don't do what she tells you.
examples.trans: 如果你不照她說的去做，她會大為光火的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sắp; sắp sửa; sớm

all_entries.word: be in good the best possible etc taste
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be acceptable in a way that will not upset or anger people

examples.en: Most of my uncle's jokes are not in good taste.
examples.trans: 我叔叔講的笑話大部分都不得體。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thích hợp với hoàn cảnh / phù hợp

all_entries.word: be in sb s good bad books
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If you are in someone's good/bad books, they are pleased/not pleased with you.

examples.en: He's in Melanie's bad books because he arrived two hours late.
examples.trans: 他遲到了兩小時，梅拉妮對他很惱火。

examples.en: I cleaned the bathroom yesterday so I'm in Mum's good books.
examples.trans: 我昨天打掃了洗手間，所以媽媽現在對我很滿意。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ghê tởm / căm ghét / không thích điều gì đó

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to have no problems after being in a difficult situation
all_entries.translation: 沒有問題；身體健康，沒有疾病

examples.en: The police breathalysed Andy last night, but he was in the clear.
examples.trans: 員警昨晚對安迪進行了呼氣酒精測試，不過他沒有問題。

examples.en: The X-rays showed that she's in the clear.
examples.trans: Ｘ光檢查顯示她身體健康。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sức khỏe / khỏe mạnh
all_entries.translation_zh: 沒有問題；身體健康，沒有疾病

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to not know about something that other people know about
all_entries.meaning_vi: hoàn toàn không hay biết (về điều gì đó) / không có ý thức về điều gì đó

all_entries.word: be in the mood for sth to do sth
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel like doing or having something

examples.en: We could go out to eat, if you're in the mood.
examples.trans: 如果你想要的話，我們可以出去吃飯。

examples.en: I'm not really in the mood for shopping.
examples.trans: 我不太想去購物。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có ý định / cố ý / quan tâm đến

all_entries.word: be in the process of doing sth
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to have started doing something

examples.en: We're still in the process of decorating the house.
examples.trans: 我們還在裝修房子。

all_entries.meaning_vi: quá trình; tiến trình

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be famous and written about in newspapers and magazines and seen on television
all_entries.translation: （在報刊、電視上）頻頻出現；廣為人知
all_entries.meaning_vi: xuất hiện / phát sinh / nổi lên / có mặt
all_entries.translation_zh: （在報刊、電視上）頻頻出現；廣為人知

all_entries.domain: Kinh tế, Tài chính, Thương mại & Kế toán (Business, Finance & Economics)
all_entries.definition_en: If you or your bank account are in the red, you owe money to the bank.

examples.en: Compare
examples.trans: be in the black

all_entries.meaning_vi: mắc nợ / lỗ / thâm hụt

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be in the same unpleasant situation as other people
all_entries.translation: 在同一艘船上； 處境相同，面臨同樣的困境；

examples.en: She's always complaining that she doesn't have enough money, but we're all in the same boat.
examples.trans: 她總是抱怨自己的錢不夠用，可是我們的處境都一樣。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giống hệt; như nhau
all_entries.translation_zh: 在同一艘船上； 處境相同，面臨同樣的困境；

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be unable to decide about something

examples.en: I was in two minds whether or not to come this morning.
examples.trans: 今天早晨要不要來，我拿不定主意。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự do dự / thiếu quyết đoán / phân vân

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be able/unable to have or do what you want
all_entries.translation: 能夠／未能如願，運氣好／差

examples.en: "Do you have any tuna sandwiches?" "You're in luck - there's one left."
examples.trans: 「你們這裡有金槍魚三明治嗎？」「你的運氣不錯——還有一個。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: được toại nguyện
all_entries.translation_zh: 能夠／未能如願，運氣好／差

all_entries.word: be known to be do sth
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If something or someone is known to be or do something, people know that it is true or happens, or that someone is or does something.

examples.en: A daily intake of 20 mg of vitamin C is known to be sufficient in most cases to ward off scurvy.
examples.trans: 眾所周知，每天攝入20毫克維生素C就足以抵禦壞血病了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ai ai cũng biết (thành ngữ)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be unable to live or work without someone or something
all_entries.translation: 離不開…，離開…將無法生活（或工作 ）

examples.en: I'm lost without my computer.
examples.trans: 我離了電腦甚麽都做不成。

examples.en: I'd be lost without you.
examples.trans: 沒有你我就沒法子生活了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể tách rời / gắn kết không thể tránh khỏi với
all_entries.translation_zh: 離不開…，離開…將無法生活（或工作 ）

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be information that someone did not know before
all_entries.translation: 對（某人）來說是新聞，某人頭一次聽說

examples.en: "I hear you and Phil are going to Boston for the weekend." "Really? That's news to me."
examples.trans: 「我聽說你和菲爾週末要去波士頓。」「真的嗎？我怎麼不知道。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: đầu tiên / lần đầu / một lần / (toán) bậc nhất (bậc một)
all_entries.translation_zh: 對（某人）來說是新聞，某人頭一次聽說

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be a great achievement

examples.en: Getting the job finished in under a week was no mean feat.
examples.trans: 一周內就把這項任務完成了，真了不起。

all_entries.meaning_vi: kinh ngạc / tuyệt vời / phi thường

all_entries.word: be nothing if not generous honest helpful etc
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used to emphasize that someone or something is extremely generous, honest, helpful, etc.
all_entries.translation: （用於強調）極其慷慨／誠實／詳盡等

examples.en: He's nothing if not charming.
examples.trans: 他魅力十足。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhấn mạnh (một tuyên bố) / nhấn mạnh
all_entries.translation_zh: （用於強調）極其慷慨／誠實／詳盡等

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be careful to avoid being tricked or getting into a dangerous situation

examples.en: You always have to be on your guard against pickpockets.
examples.trans: 你要時時提防扒手。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đề phòng / cảnh giác / coi chừng không (sẩy chân) / cách phát âm Đài Loan [ti2 fang2]

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be extremely happy and excited
all_entries.translation: 高興極了；異常興奮；樂不可支

examples.en: "Was Helen pleased about getting that job?" "Pleased? She was on cloud nine!"
examples.trans: 「海倫得到那份工作高興嗎？」「豈止是高興？她簡直飄飄然了！」

all_entries.meaning_vi: vui mừng khôn xiết (thành ngữ); vui sướng như điên
all_entries.translation_zh: 高興極了；異常興奮；樂不可支

all_entries.word: be on good friendly etc terms with sb
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to have a good, friendly, etc. relationship with someone
all_entries.translation: （與某人）關係好，關係友好（等等）

examples.en: My ex-wife and I are still on friendly terms.
examples.trans: 我跟前妻仍然關係友好。

examples.en: Are you on good terms with your boss?
examples.trans: 你跟老闆關係好嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: quận Hữu Hảo của thành phố Y Xuân 伊春市[Yi1 chun1 shi4], Hắc Long Giang
all_entries.translation_zh: （與某人）關係好，關係友好（等等）

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be quick to understand and react to things

examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night and I'm not really on the ball today.
examples.trans: 我昨晚沒有睡好，所以今天反應遲鈍。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thông minh / nhanh trí

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be likely to happen

examples.en: "So you think they'll get married next year?" "I think it's on the cards."
examples.trans: 「那麽你認為他們明年會結婚嗎？」「我看很有可能。」

all_entries.meaning_vi: có thể (xảy ra) / có khả năng / có xác suất / khả năng / xác suất / có lẽ / có thể

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be at risk
all_entries.translation: 面臨危險，處於危險之中

examples.en: Almost 3,000 jobs have been lost recently, and a further 3,000 are on the line.
examples.trans: 最近已有將近3000人失去了工作，另外還有3000人也面臨著失業的危險。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bên trong / giữa / đang trong lúc (làm gì đó) / trong suốt
all_entries.translation_zh: 面臨危險，處於危險之中

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: (of two or more people) to think in a similar way and to understand each other well
all_entries.translation: （兩人或多人）觀點相投，合得來

examples.en: What makes the problem worse is that Howard and Tina are not on the same wavelength about how to deal with it.
examples.trans: 讓問題變得更糟糕的是霍華德跟天娜在如何解決問題方面意見不合。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hòa hợp / hợp nhau / cũng viết 和得來|和得来[he2 de5 lai2]
all_entries.translation_zh: （兩人或多人）觀點相投，合得來

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be very unusual and special

examples.en: He's one of a kind, he really is.
examples.trans: 他獨一無二，確實如此。

all_entries.meaning_vi: độc nhất vô nhị (thành ngữ); không ai sánh kịp / không gì so sánh được

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be an event that cannot possibly happen

examples.en: A trip to New Zealand is out of the question this year.
examples.trans: 今年的紐西蘭之旅不可能成行了。

examples.en: There's no question of agreeing to the demands.
examples.trans: 這些要求是不可能被同意的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể / không thể nào / không có khả năng

all_entries.word: be part and parcel of sth
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be a feature of something, especially a feature that cannot be avoided
all_entries.translation: 是…必要（或不可缺少）的部分

examples.en: Being recognized in the street is part and parcel of being a celebrity.
examples.trans: 走在街上被人認出是身為名人在所難免的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể thiếu được
all_entries.translation_zh: 是…必要（或不可缺少）的部分

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be at the rate of something
all_entries.translation: 保持在特定水準；達到…比率

examples.en: Inflation is running at 10 percent.
examples.trans: 通貨膨脹率達10%。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giữ / duy trì / nắm giữ / bảo tồn
all_entries.translation_zh: 保持在特定水準；達到…比率

all_entries.word: be sb s own flesh and blood
all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be someone's relation

examples.en: I couldn't send him away - he's my own flesh and blood.
examples.trans: 我不能把他送走——他是我的親人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: người thân thiết

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to have so much work that you have problems dealing with it all

examples.en: I'm absolutely snowed under with work at the moment.
examples.trans: 眼前我正爲手頭的工作忙得不可開交。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rất (bận rộn, v.v.)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used to describe a person or thing in a way that is partly true but not completely or exactly
all_entries.translation: 有些像，在某種程度上是

examples.en: It came as something of a surprise.
examples.trans: 這件事多少有些讓人感到意外。

examples.en: He has a reputation as something of a troublemaker.
examples.trans: 在某種程度上，他是一個製造麻煩的人，這可是出了名的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một số / hơi
all_entries.translation_zh: 有些像，在某種程度上是

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be much better or much more advanced than another thing or person
all_entries.translation: （比另一物或人）好得多，明顯領先

examples.en: The latest sales figures show that we're streets ahead of the competition.
examples.trans: 最新銷售數字顯示，我們在競爭中遙遙領先。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khác / một cái khác
all_entries.translation_zh: （比另一物或人）好得多，明顯領先

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be an activity or action that you will get an advantage from

examples.en: It's worth your while taking out travel insurance before you travel.
examples.trans: 在旅行前購買旅行保險是值得的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đáng / đáng để

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be the best decision or choice

examples.en: Your best bet would be to take a bus to the airport.
examples.trans: 你最好坐公車到機場。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có lý trí / khôn ngoan / sáng suốt / minh mẫn

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be the only person or thing that might be able to help you, when every other person or possibility has failed
all_entries.translation: 是最後的求助對象；是最後的出路；是最後的辦法

examples.en: You have to help me - you're my last resort.
examples.trans: 你一定要幫我——你是我最後的希望了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lối thoát (nghĩa đen và bóng) / cơ hội thăng tiến; một con đường phía trước / lối ra (cho sản phẩm)
all_entries.translation_zh: 是最後的求助對象；是最後的出路；是最後的辦法

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be hurt or deceived by someone or something bad
all_entries.translation: 成為…的犧牲品，被…欺騙；深受…之害

examples.en: Small children are prey to all sorts of fears.
examples.trans: 幼童深受各種恐懼的折磨。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nạn nhân hy sinh / người bị xem là không quan trọng / mặt hàng bán lỗ
all_entries.translation_zh: 成為…的犧牲品，被…欺騙；深受…之害

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be or feel ill

examples.trans: 估計地方議會將贊同委員會的提議。

examples.en: The pain was bad beyond endurance.
examples.trans: 疼痛劇烈，令人難以忍受。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự chịu đựng; khả năng chịu đựng; tính nhẫn nại; sự kéo dài

all_entries.translation: 使服從（法律）；（強制）實行，執行，把…強加於

examples.en: It isn't always easy for the police to enforce speed limits.
examples.trans: 對員警來說，嚴格執行限速規定並不總是件易事。

examples.en: The new teacher had failed to enforce any sort of discipline.
examples.trans: 這位新教師一點都管不住學生，搞得紀律渙散。

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm cho có hiệu lực, làm cho có sức mạnh (một lý lẽ), đòi cho được (một yêu sách); ép làm, thúc ép, ép buộc (một việc gì); bắt tôn trọng, bắt tuân theo; đem thi hành (luật lệ)

examples.trans: 我僱用了一名秘書來處理我全部的文書工作。

examples.en: We're engaging the services of a professional administrator.
examples.trans: 我們將聘用專業管理人員爲我們服務。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hẹn, hứa hẹn, ước hẹn, cam kết; đính ước, hứa hôn; thuê (người ở); giữ trước (chỗ ngồi...); lấy (danh dự...) mà cam kết

examples.trans: 兩國政府已經同意開展全面對話以解決該問題。

examples.en: Once Mrs Kirkpatrick engages you in conversation, you're stuck with her for half an hour.
examples.trans: 一旦柯克派翠克夫人跟你聊起來，不說上半個小時她是不會放過你的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tham gia / tham dự

examples.trans: 她看書看得太入迷了，以至於忘了烤箱中正烤著餅乾。

examples.en: They were so engrossed in/with what they were doing that they didn't hear me come in.
examples.trans: 他們全神貫注地做著手上的事，連我進去都沒有聽見。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tập trung toàn bộ sự chú ý (thành ngữ) / chú ý hoàn toàn
all_entries.translation_zh: 全神貫注的；專心致志的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 這些醜聞並不會提高這個組織的聲譽。

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm tăng, nâng cao, đề cao, làm nổi bật (đức tính, quyền hạn...); tăng (giá...)

examples.trans: 我真的很喜歡那部電影／那本書／那場音樂會／那次派對／那頓飯。

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] I want to travel because I enjoy meeting people and seeing new places.
examples.trans: 我想去旅遊，因爲我喜愛結識不同的人，見識沒去過的地方。

all_entries.translation: 受夠了；煩透了；再也無法忍受了

examples.en: Is there enough dessert/Are there enough desserts for everyone?
examples.trans: 甜點夠大家吃嗎？

examples.en: There are 25 textbooks per class. That should be enough.
examples.trans: 每班25本教材，應該夠了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đủ

examples.trans: 化肥可以提高土壤肥沃度。

examples.en: My life was greatly enriched by knowing her.
examples.trans: 認識了她，讓我的生活變得非常充實。

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm giàu, làm giàu thêm, làm phong phú; làm tốt thêm, làm màu mỡ thêm; bón phân (đất trồng); cho vitamin vào (thức ăn, bánh mì...)

examples.en: You will begin to feel sleepy as the drug enters the bloodstream.
examples.trans: 藥物進入血液後你就會開始感到昏昏欲睡。

examples.trans: 不要忘記這是一個商業組織——我們到這兒來是爲了賺錢的。

examples.en: Those were the years of private enterprise (= businesses being run privately, rather than by the government), when lots of small businesses were started.
examples.trans: 那是一個私人企業的時代，許多小公司就是那時創建的。

all_entries.translation_zh: 環境保護主義者；環境保護論者

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhìn thẳng vào mặt (ai); đương đầu với (sự nguy hiểm, sự việc...); dự tính, vạch ra (kế hoạch...); nhìn trước

examples.trans: 她與人初次見面就能侃侃而談，這真讓我羡慕。

examples.trans: 爲所有那些人做飯，你這種工作我一點都不羨慕。

examples.trans: 經濟管理包括控制通貨膨脹、降低失業率等複雜的因素。

examples.en: There is a tendency in movies to make the equation between violence and excitement.
examples.trans: 電影傾向於把暴力和刺激畫上等號。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phương trình; in line coordinates phương trình theo toạ độ đường; e. in point coordinates phương trình theo toạ độ điểm

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 他們學校的教學設備很簡陋。

examples.en: We were well equipped for the trip.
examples.trans: 那次旅行，我們都裝備齊全。

all_entries.meaning_vi: công cụ / dụng cụ / đồ dùng / phương tiện (để đạt mục tiêu v.v.)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 政府聲稱正盡其所能根治腐敗。

examples.en: The disease that once claimed millions of lives has now been eradicated.
examples.trans: 這種曾奪去數百萬人生命的疾病現在已被根除了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhổ rễ; trừ tiệt

examples.trans: 這些雕像遭受風雨侵蝕，成了一堆堆不成形的亂石。

examples.trans: 這些懸崖每年都被侵蝕掉數英尺。

examples.en: The survey reveals a gradual erosion of the president's popularity and support.
examples.trans: 民意調查顯示了總統聲望和所獲支持的逐漸削弱。

examples.trans: 水土流失/海岸侵蝕

examples.en: The survey reveals a gradual erosion of the president's popularity and support.
examples.trans: 民意調查顯示了總統聲望和所獲支持的逐漸削弱。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự xói mòn, sự ăn mòn

examples.trans: 她認為200萬美元的出價完全不夠，因而拒絕了。

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.en: This work is woefully (= extremely) inadequate - you'll have to do it again.
examples.trans: 這工作做得非常糟糕——你必須重做。

examples.en: She rejected the $2 million offer as totally inadequate.
examples.trans: 她認為200萬美元的出價完全不夠，因而拒絕了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không tương xứng, không xứng, không thích đáng, không thoả đáng; không đủ, không đầy đủ, thiếu; không thể thích nghi đầy đủ với xã hội; không trưởng thành được về tâm lý

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: unsuitable

examples.en: His casual behaviour was wholly inappropriate for such a formal occasion.
examples.trans: 他隨便的舉止在這樣正式的場合十分不恰當。

examples.en: I think it would be inappropriate (for you) to invite her to a party so soon after her husband's death.
examples.trans: 我認為（你）在她丈夫剛去世不久就邀請她參加聚會是不合適的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thích hợp, không thích đáng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: unable to do something

examples.en: He seems incapable of walking past a music shop without going in and buying another CD.
examples.trans: 他似乎做不到經過唱片行卻不進去再買張光碟。

examples.en: I think she's incapable of love.
examples.trans: 我覺得她不懂得如何愛別人。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể, kém năng lực, không có khả năng; i. of solution không giải được

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: something that encourages a person to do something

examples.en: Tax incentives have been very effective in encouraging people to save and invest more of their income.
examples.trans: 稅收措施在鼓勵人們將收入多儲蓄和多投資方面很有效。

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] There is little incentive for people to leave their cars at home when public transport remains so expensive.
examples.trans: 公共交通的費用居高不下，無法激勵人們停開私家車。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khuyến khích, khích lệ; thúc đẩy; sự khuyến khích, sự khích lệ; sự thúc đẩy; động cơ (thúc đẩy làm việc gì)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used before saying something that is not as important as the main subject of conversation, but is connected to it in some way

examples.en: We had a marvellous meal at that restaurant you recommended - incidentally, I must give you the number of a similar one I know.
examples.trans: 我們在你推薦的那家餐館大快朵頤了一頓——對了，我一定要把我知道的類似的一家餐館的電話號碼給你。

examples.en: Incidentally, I wanted to have a word with you about your travel expenses.
examples.trans: 順便說一句，我打算和你談一下你的開支報銷問題。

all_entries.meaning_vi: ngẫu nhiên, tình cờ, bất ngờ; nhân tiện, nhân thể, nhân đây

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a feeling that you want to do a particular thing, or the fact that you prefer or are more likely to do a particular thing

examples.en: [ + to infinitive ] My own inclination would be to look for another job.
examples.trans: 我個人傾向另外找一份工作。

examples.en: We should be basing our decisions on solid facts, not inclinations and hunches.
examples.trans: 我們應根據可靠的事實作出決定，而不是根據個人愛好和直覺。

all_entries.meaning_vi: độ nghiêng, góc nghiêng; i. of ecliptic độ nghiêng của hàng đạo; i. of a line in the space góc nghiêng của đường thẳng trong không gian

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: likely or wanting to do something

examples.en: Tom is inclined to be lazy.
examples.trans: 湯姆喜歡偷懶。

examples.en: No one seemed inclined to help.
examples.trans: 似乎沒有人願意幫忙。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị nghiêng, bị lệch

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: having natural artistic, technical, etc. ability
all_entries.translation: 在藝術／技術等方面有天賦的

examples.en: Tom is inclined to be lazy.
examples.trans: 湯姆喜歡偷懶。

examples.en: No one seemed inclined to help.
examples.trans: 似乎沒有人願意幫忙。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị nghiêng, bị lệch
all_entries.translation_zh: 在藝術／技術等方面有天賦的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to have an opinion about something, but not a strong opinion

examples.en: Tom is inclined to be lazy.
examples.trans: 湯姆喜歡偷懶。

examples.en: No one seemed inclined to help.
examples.trans: 似乎沒有人願意幫忙。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị nghiêng, bị lệch

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the act of including someone or something as part of a group, list, etc., or a person or thing that is included

examples.en: She is being considered for inclusion in the Olympic team.
examples.trans: 正在考慮讓她選入奧運會隊。

examples.en: The book's value stems from its inclusion of multiple viewpoints.
examples.trans: 這本書的價值源於它包括了不同的視點。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự bao hàm, liene hệ bao hàm, bao hàm thức; i. of sets bao hàm thức tập hợp

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: An inclusive price or amount includes everything.

examples.en: My rent is $700 a month inclusive (of bills).
examples.trans: 我的租金是每月700美元全包。

examples.en: I'll be away from 20 to 31 May inclusive.
examples.trans: 我將於5月20日至31日外出。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bao hàm chứa

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: impossible to imagine or think of
all_entries.translation: 不能想像的；不可思議的

examples.en: The idea that they might not win was inconceivable to them.
examples.trans: 他們可能贏不了的念頭對他們來說是不可想像的。

examples.en: It would be inconceivable for her to change her mind.
examples.trans: 要她改變主意是不可想像的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể hiểu được, không thể nhận thức được; không thể tưởng tượng được; kỳ lạ, phi thường
all_entries.translation_zh: 不能想像的；不可思議的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: not thinking or worrying about other people or their feelings
all_entries.translation: 不體諒別人的；不為他人著想的，自私的

examples.en: Our neighbours are very inconsiderate - they're always playing loud music late at night.
examples.trans: 我們的鄰居一點也不替別人著想——他們總是深夜還把音樂開得很響。

examples.en: Synonym
examples.trans: selfish

all_entries.meaning_vi: thiếu ân cần, thiếu chu đáo, thiếu quan tâm; thiếu thận trọng, thiếu suy nghĩ, khinh suất
all_entries.translation_zh: 不體諒別人的；不為他人著想的，自私的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a state or an example of problems or trouble, often causing a delay or loss of comfort

examples.en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the late arrival of the train.
examples.trans: 我們對火車延誤所造成的一切不便表示歉意。

examples.en: We had the inconvenience of being unable to use the kitchen for several weeks.
examples.trans: 我們有幾個星期不能使用廚房，很不方便。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự bất tiện, sự phiền phức; làm phiền, quấy rầy

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to include something as part of something larger

examples.en: Suggestions from the survey have been incorporated into/in the final design.
examples.trans: 調查中取得的建議已被納入最終的設計之中。

examples.en: This aircraft incorporates several new safety features.
examples.trans: 這種飛機具有幾個新的安全功能。

all_entries.meaning_vi: kết hợp chặt chẽ; hợp thành tổ chức, hợp thành đoàn thể; sáp nhập, hợp nhất, kết hợp chặt chẽ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: increasing

examples.en: Incidents of armed robbery have increased over the last few years.
examples.trans: 持械搶劫案近幾年增多了。

examples.en: The cost of the project has increased dramatically/significantly since it began.
examples.trans: 該專案自開始以來成本就急劇上升。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tăng, lớn lên // (thống kê) sự phát triển (sản xuất)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used for saying that something is very difficult to believe

examples.en: Incredibly, no one was hurt in the accident.
examples.trans: 意外中居然沒有人受傷，這真是令人難以置信。

examples.en: He was incredibly rich/angry/quick.
examples.trans: 他極其富有／生氣／迅速。

all_entries.meaning_vi: khó tin nổi, đáng kinh ngạc, đến nỗi không ngờ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to experience something, usually something unpleasant, as a result of actions you have taken

examples.en: to incur debts/fines/bills
examples.trans: 招致債務／遭到罰款／要付帳

examples.en: The play has incurred the wrath/anger of both audiences and critics.
examples.trans: 這部劇引起了觀眾和評論家的憤怒。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chịu, gánh, mắc, bị

all_entries.domain: Y tế, Dược học & Khoa học não bộ (Medicine, Pharmacy & Neuroscience)
all_entries.definition_en: not able to be cured

examples.en: Parkinson's disease is a debilitating and incurable disease of the nervous system.
examples.trans: 巴金森氏症是一種使人虛弱、無法治癒的神經系統疾病。

examples.en: an incurable romantic/optimist/pessimist
examples.trans: 無可救藥的浪漫主義者／樂天派／悲觀主義者

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể chữa được (bệnh); người bị bệnh không thể chữa được

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: used to add some extra information that develops or supports something you have just said

examples.en: Indeed, it could be the worst environmental disaster in Europe this century.
examples.trans: 這確實可能是本世紀西歐最嚴重的環境災難。

examples.en: Evidence suggests that errors may indeed be occurring.
examples.trans: 證據顯示可能確實出錯了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thực vậy

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: for a period of time with no fixed end
all_entries.translation: 不確定地；不清楚地；無限期地

examples.en: The negotiations have been put off/postponed indefinitely.
examples.trans: 談判被無限延期了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mập mờ; vô hạn định, không biết đến bao giờ
all_entries.translation_zh: 不確定地；不清楚地；無限期地

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: an alphabetical list, such as one printed at the back of a book showing which page a subject, name, etc. is on
all_entries.translation: （書後關於主題、姓名等的）索引

examples.en: Try looking up "heart disease" in the index.
examples.trans: 試試在索引中尋找「心臟病」這個條目。

examples.en: He still has all his friends' names and addresses on a card index.
examples.trans: 他仍然使用卡片索引記錄所有朋友的姓名及地址。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chỉ số; cấp; bảng tra chữ cái; in of a circuit chỉ số của một mạch; i. of cograduation chỉ số tương quan hạng
all_entries.translation_zh: （書後關於主題、姓名等的）索引

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a sign that something exists, is true, or is likely to happen

examples.en: There are few indications (that) the economy is on an upswing.
examples.trans: 沒有甚麼跡象顯示經濟正在好轉。

examples.en: Helen's face gave no indication of what she was thinking.
examples.trans: 從海倫的臉上看不出她在想甚麼。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự chỉ; số chỉ; sự biểu thị, sự biểu lộ; dấu hiệu; sự chỉ dẫn (về cách dùng thuốc)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: something that shows what a situation is like

examples.en: Commodity prices can be a useful indicator of inflation, he claimed.
examples.trans: 他聲稱，商品價格可以作為一種有用的通貨膨脹指標。

examples.en: an economic indicator
examples.trans: 經濟指標

all_entries.meaning_vi: làm chỉ tiêu; bộ phận chỉ; signal i. bộ phận chỉ dấu hiệu; speed i. bộ phận chỉ tốc độ

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: lack of interest in someone or something
all_entries.translation: 不感興趣；漠不關心，冷淡

examples.en: Many native speakers of a language show indifference to/towards grammatical points.
examples.trans: 許多人都不關注其母語的文法。

examples.en: His attitude was one of bored indifference.
examples.trans: 他的態度既不耐煩又漠不關心。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự không phân biệt, phiếm định
all_entries.translation_zh: 不感興趣；漠不關心，冷淡

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: not thinking about or interested in someone or something
all_entries.translation: 不感興趣的；不關心的，冷淡的

examples.en: Why don't you vote - how can you be so indifferent (to what is going on)?
examples.trans: 你為甚麼不投票？你怎能（對正在發生的事情）如此漠不關心！

examples.en: He found it very hard teaching a class full of indifferent teenagers.
examples.trans: 他發覺教一班無動於衷的十幾歲的孩子真是頭痛。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không phân biệt
all_entries.translation_zh: 不感興趣的；不關心的，冷淡的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: happening in addition to an intended result, often in a way that is complicated or not obvious

examples.en: The benefits from pure research are often indirect.
examples.trans: 純理論研究帶來的益處常常是間接的。

examples.en: Indirect effects of the fighting include disease and food shortages.
examples.trans: 戰爭的間接後果包括疾病肆虐及食物短缺。

all_entries.meaning_vi: gián tiếp

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: not following a straight line, or not directly or simply connected

examples.en: The benefits from pure research are often indirect.
examples.trans: 純理論研究帶來的益處常常是間接的。

examples.en: Indirect effects of the fighting include disease and food shortages.
examples.trans: 戰爭的間接後果包括疾病肆虐及食物短缺。

all_entries.meaning_vi: gián tiếp

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: Something or someone that is indispensable is so good or important that you could not manage without it, him, or her.

examples.en: This book is an indispensable resource for researchers.
examples.trans: 這本書是研究人員必不可少的資料。

examples.en: His long experience at the United Nations makes him indispensable to the talks.
examples.trans: 在聯合國長期的工作經驗使他成為談判中不可或缺的人物。

all_entries.meaning_vi: rất cần thiết, không thể thiếu được; bắt buộc, không thể bỏ qua (luật pháp, trách nhiệm...); người rất cần thiết, vật rất cần thiết

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: true, and impossible to doubt
all_entries.translation: 不容置疑的，無可爭辯的

examples.en: an artist of indisputable skill
examples.trans: 技藝無可置疑的藝術家

examples.en: One fact is indisputable - this must never be allowed to happen again.
examples.trans: 有一點是不容置疑的——就是這種事絕不能再次發生。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không thể cãi, không thể bàn cãi, không thể tranh luận
all_entries.translation_zh: 不容置疑的，無可爭辯的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a person who thinks or behaves in their own original way
all_entries.translation: （思想或行為）與眾不同的人，有個性的人

examples.en: Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.
examples.trans: 每個人都有一些不可剝奪的權利。

examples.en: Like many creative individuals, she can be very bad-tempered.
examples.trans: 像許多富有創造力的人一樣，她的脾氣有時會很不好。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cá thể
all_entries.translation_zh: （思想或行為）與眾不同的人，有個性的人

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the qualities that make a person or thing different from others

examples.en: It's a competent essay but it lacks individuality.
examples.trans: 這是一篇不錯的文章，但缺乏個性。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tính cá thể

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: separately

examples.en: The children will first sing individually and then as a group.
examples.trans: 孩子將首先分別獨唱，然後再一起合唱。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cá nhân, cá thể, riêng biệt, riêng lẻ, từng người một, từng cái một

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to allow yourself or another person to have something enjoyable, especially more than is good for you

examples.en: The soccer fans indulged their patriotism, waving flags and singing songs.
examples.trans: 足球迷搖著旗唱著歌，縱情抒發他們的愛國熱情。

examples.en: I love champagne but I don't often indulge myself.
examples.trans: 我愛喝香檳，但一般都有節制。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nuông chiều, chiều theo; nuôi, ấp ủ, theo đuổi; làm thích thú, làm thoả thích, làm vui thú

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the process of developing industries in a country
all_entries.meaning_vi: Công nghiệp hoá (ở các nước đang phát triển).

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: having developed a lot of industry
all_entries.meaning_vi: công nghiệp hóa / quá trình công nghiệp hóa

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: An industrious person works hard.

examples.en: an industrious worker
examples.trans: 勤勞的工人

examples.en: She's extremely competent and industrious.
examples.trans: 她非常勤奮、能幹。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cần cù, siêng năng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: not suitable as food
all_entries.translation: 不可食用的，不適合食用的

examples.trans: 你難道不覺得她昨天在聚會上表現得很古怪嗎？

examples.en: Oddly enough (= this is strange/surprising), she didn't mention anything about the fact that she was getting married.
examples.trans: 真奇怪，她隻字未提自己要結婚這件事。

examples.trans: 如果你一輩子開車的話，你有可能在某一時刻發生車禍。

examples.trans: 在如此惡劣的經濟環境下人們成功的可能性很小。

examples.en: Keep the dog on the lead or he'll just run off.
examples.trans: 好好牽著狗，不然它就會跑掉的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tắt; đi, đi rồi; ra khỏi, đứt, rời

all_entries.meaning_vi: nghĩa đen: dấu chân người thưa thớt (thành ngữ) / nghĩa bóng: hẻo lánh / hiu quạnh / vắng vẻ

all_entries.translation: 令人不快的；令人煩惱的，討人厭的

examples.trans: 他有些好鬥，這讓許多人初次見他時都感覺有些厭惡。

examples.trans: 我覺得煩心的是要讓你幹那麼多的活。

examples.trans: 這些紀錄無論如何都不能變動。

examples.trans: 我繳付稅款。

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to be punished for doing something bad to someone else, or to suffer because of a mistake that you made
all_entries.translation: 為…付出代價，因…得到報應

examples.en: We all pay for our mistakes in some way at some time.
examples.trans: 我們都會在某個時候以某種方式為我們所犯的錯誤付出代價。

examples.en: He tricked me and I'm going to make him pay for it!
examples.trans: 他欺騙了我，我會讓他得到報應的！

all_entries.meaning_vi: trả; bỏ ra; đầu tư (năng lượng hoặc thời gian)
all_entries.translation_zh: 為…付出代價，因…得到報應

all_entries.meaning_vi: tăng lương

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to experience the bad result of something you have done

examples.trans: 如果你現在糟蹋自己的身體，年紀大了會吃苦頭的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chịu khổ / chịu hậu quả hành động của mình / trả giá đắt / bị vạ lây

examples.trans: 請寫明你的支票抬頭人為WWF。

examples.en: Interest payments are payable monthly.
examples.trans: 利息每月支付。

examples.en: Please make your cheque payable to WWF.
examples.trans: 請寫明你的支票抬頭人為WWF。

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a person who owns or rents a small piece of land and grows crops, keeps animals, etc. on it, especially one who has a low income, very little education, and a low social position. This is usually used of someone who lived in the past or of someone in a poor country.
all_entries.translation: （通常指舊時或貧窮國家的）農民，農夫

examples.en: Tons of internationally donated food was distributed to the starving peasants.
examples.trans: 數噸國際社會所捐贈的食品被分給了這些飢餓的農民。

examples.en: Most of the produce sold in the market is grown by peasant farmers.
examples.trans: 市場上出售的大部分產品是由自耕農民種植的。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nông dân
all_entries.translation_zh: （通常指舊時或貧窮國家的）農民，農夫

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 她的想法非常古怪。

all_entries.meaning_vi: riêng; đặc biệt

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.en: Close your eyes. Don't peek. I've got a surprise for you.
examples.trans: 閉上眼睛，別偷看，我要給你一個驚喜。

examples.en: I peeked out the window to see who was there.
examples.trans: 我偷偷向窗外望去，想看看誰在那裡。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hé nhìn, lé nhìn

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to look at something for a short time

examples.trans: 閉上眼睛，別偷看，我要給你一個驚喜。

examples.en: I peeked out the window to see who was there.
examples.trans: 我偷偷向窗外望去，想看看誰在那裡。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hé nhìn, lé nhìn

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If a layer or covering peels, it slowly comes off, and if you peel a layer or covering, you remove it slowly and carefully.
all_entries.translation: （表層）脫落，剝落；剝去（表層），剝去…的殼

examples.en: Peel, core, and chop the apples.
examples.trans: 把蘋果去皮、去核並剁碎。

examples.en: We peeled the wallpaper off the walls.
examples.trans: 我們把壁紙從牆上撕了下來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tháp vuông (ở Ê-cốt); xẻng (để xúc bánh vào lò); cá đù
all_entries.translation_zh: （表層）脫落，剝落；剝去（表層），剝去…的殼

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to secretly look at something for a short time, usually through a hole

examples.trans: 我看見她透過窗簾／向房間裡偷看。

examples.en: A few early flowers had peeped up through the snow.
examples.trans: 幾朵早開的花從雪地裡探出頭來。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tiếng kêu chít chít, tiếng kêu chim chiếp (chuột, chim...); kêu chít chít, kêu chim chiếp (chuột, chim...); cái nhìn hé (qua khe cửa...)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 沒有人開門，她就費力地透過窗戶往裡望去，看是否有人在。

examples.en: The driver was peering into the distance trying to read the road sign.
examples.trans: 司機費力地看著遠方，想要看清路標。

all_entries.meaning_vi: người cùng địa vị xã hội, người ngang hàng, người tương đương; khanh tướng (Anh), người quý tộc; huân tước; thượng nghị sĩ (Anh)

examples.en: The driver was peering into the distance trying to read the road sign.
examples.trans: 司機費力地看著遠方，想要看清路標。

all_entries.meaning_vi: người cùng địa vị xã hội, người ngang hàng, người tương đương; khanh tướng (Anh), người quý tộc; huân tước; thượng nghị sĩ (Anh)
all_entries.translation_zh: 同齡人；同輩；同儕；同等社會地位（或能力）的人

examples.trans: 我們邀請了30個人來參加聚會。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dân tộc; nhân dân, dân chúng, quần chúng; người

examples.trans: 你認為完美的幸福是怎麼樣的？

examples.trans: 大多數金融分析師都對這種持續的衰退感到驚訝。

examples.en: Her persistence and enthusiasm have helped the group to achieve its international success.
examples.trans: 她的堅持不懈和滿腔熱忱幫助該集團在國際上獲得成功。

all_entries.translation_zh: 持續存在；堅持不懈，執意

examples.trans: 持續不散的氣味／頑固的皮膚疹

examples.en: Symptoms of the illness include a high temperature and a persistent dry cough.
examples.trans: 此疾病症狀包括高燒和持久乾咳。

examples.trans: 我個人認為學生應該多做一些課外作業。

examples.en: Her uncle takes a personal interest in her progress.

all_entries.meaning_vi: đích thân, với tư cách cá nhân (không đại diện bởi người khác); bản thân; về phần tôi, đối với tôi

examples.trans: 我網球打得不錯，不過我需要練習發球。

examples.en: They failed to take the necessary precautions to avoid infection.
examples.trans: 他們未能採取必要的預防措施來避免感染。

examples.trans: 煙火在八點整開始燃放。

examples.trans: 我的前任做這份工作做了12年。

examples.trans: 最新款的法拉利賽車不僅比舊款的更快，而且更舒適。

examples.trans: 你們解決交通問題了嗎？

examples.en: The couple resolved their differences and made an effort to get along.
examples.trans: 這對夫妻消除了他們之間的分歧，盡力融洽相處。

all_entries.translation: （別無辦法的情況下）訴諸，依靠，採用

examples.en: I had to resort to violence/threats to get my money.
examples.trans: 為了拿到我的錢，我被迫訴諸暴力／採取威脅的手段。

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] When she didn't answer the phone, I resorted to calling up to her from the street.
examples.trans: 她不接我的電話，我沒有辦法，只好站在街上對她大喊。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dựa vào cái gì đó (để hỗ trợ, v.v.); phụ thuộc vào
all_entries.translation_zh: （別無辦法的情況下）訴諸，依靠，採用

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: skilled at solving problems and making decisions on your own

examples.en: She's a very resourceful manager.
examples.trans: 她是一位非常有智謀的經理。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có tài xoay xở, tháo vát, nhiều thủ đoạn, nhiều tài vặt

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: A respectable amount or quality is large enough or of a good enough standard to be acceptable.
all_entries.translation: （數量）足夠的；質量不錯的；相當好的

examples.en: a respectable young woman from a good family
examples.trans: 出身良好、端莊賢淑的年輕女子

examples.en: This part of the city has become quite respectable in the last ten years.
examples.trans: 在過去的十年中，這一城區已經變得相當好。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đáng trọng; đáng kính; đứng đắn, đoan trang, chỉnh tề; kha khá, khá lớn, đáng kể
all_entries.translation_zh: （數量）足夠的；質量不錯的；相當好的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: showing admiration for someone or something
all_entries.translation: 畢恭畢敬的；表示尊敬的；尊重的

examples.en: "We're so pleased to meet you at last," he said in a respectful tone of voice.
examples.trans: 「我們終於和您見面了，真是萬分高興，」他畢恭畢敬地說道。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: disrespectful

all_entries.meaning_vi: lễ phép; kính cẩn, bày tỏ sự kính trọng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: showing politeness or honour to someone or something
all_entries.translation: 恭敬的；按照禮儀的；有禮貌的

examples.en: "We're so pleased to meet you at last," he said in a respectful tone of voice.
examples.trans: 「我們終於和您見面了，真是萬分高興，」他畢恭畢敬地說道。

examples.en: Opposite
examples.trans: disrespectful

all_entries.meaning_vi: lễ phép; kính cẩn, bày tỏ sự kính trọng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: in a way that shows you want to be polite or honour someone

examples.en: When she was asked if she had any ambition to become prime minister, she respectfully (= politely) declined to answer the question.
examples.trans: 當被問及她是否有問鼎首相職位的抱負時，她婉言回避了這個問題。

examples.en: As the body was carried through the crowd, people drew back respectfully (= to show their respect).
examples.trans: 當遺體被抬過人群時，人們滿懷敬意地退後讓道。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lễ phép; kính cẩn, bày tỏ sự kính trọng
