all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: relating or belonging to each of the separate people or things you have just mentioned

examples.en: Everyone would go into the hall for assembly and then afterwards we'd go to our respective classes.
examples.trans: 所有人都去禮堂參加集會，會後各自回各自的班級。

examples.en: Clinton and Zedillo ordered their respective Cabinets to devise a common counter-drug strategy.
examples.trans: 克林頓和塞迪略命令他們各自的內閣制訂兩國共同的反毒品戰略。

all_entries.meaning_vi: riêng từng người, riêng từng cái; tương ứng (với vị trí, thứ tự, địa vị...)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to start something again
all_entries.translation: （使）重新開始；（使）再開始；重新啓動

examples.en: Our car stalled and wouldn't restart.
examples.trans: 我們的車拋了錨，發動不起來了。

examples.en: Please restart your computer to complete installation.
examples.trans: 請重啓電腦完成安裝。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lại bắt đầu, lại khởi đầu
all_entries.translation_zh: （使）重新開始；（使）再開始；重新啓動

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: unwilling or unable to stay still or to be quiet and calm, because you are worried or bored
all_entries.translation: 呆不住的；坐立不安的，焦躁的

examples.en: He's a restless type - he never stays in one country for long.
examples.trans: 他是那種待不住的人——他從來不在一個國家停留太長的時間。

examples.en: She spent a restless night (= she did not sleep well), tossing and turning.
examples.trans: 她在床上輾轉反側，一夜無眠。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không nghỉ, không ngừng; không yên, luôn luôn động đậy, hiếu động; không nghỉ được, không ngủ được, thao thức; bồn chồn, áy náy
all_entries.translation_zh: 呆不住的；坐立不安的，焦躁的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If you restore a quality or ability that someone has not had for a long time, you make it possible for them to have that quality or ability again.

examples.en: The badly neglected paintings have all been carefully restored.
examples.trans: 那些由於嚴重疏忽而損毀的畫作得到了精心修復。

examples.en: After a week in bed, she was fully restored to health (= she felt healthy again).
examples.trans: 臥床一週後，她完全恢復了健康。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phục hồi, xây dựng lại

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to control the actions or behaviour of someone by force, especially in order to stop them from doing something, or to limit the growth or force of something

examples.en: When he started fighting, it took four police officers to restrain him.
examples.trans: 他出手打人，四個員警才把他制服。

examples.en: She was so angry that she could hardly restrain herself.
examples.trans: 她氣得幾乎都控制不住自己。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giới hạn, hạn chế

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

examples.en: measures to restrict the sale of alcohol
examples.trans: 限制酒類銷售的措施

examples.en: The government has restricted freedom of movement into and out of the country.
examples.trans: 政府已經限制出入境自由了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hạn chế, thu hẹp

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: limited, especially by official rules, laws, etc.
all_entries.translation: 受（尤指官方法規等）限制的，受約束的

examples.en: Building in this area of town is restricted.
examples.trans: 在該城區建房是受限制的。

examples.en: Membership is restricted to (= it is only for) chief executive officers.
examples.trans: 能獲得會員資格的人只限於首席執行官們。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bị hạn chế, bị thu hẹp
all_entries.translation_zh: 受（尤指官方法規等）限制的，受約束的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: an official limit on something
all_entries.translation: 受（尤指官方）限制的，受約束的

examples.en: import/export/currency restrictions
examples.trans: 進口／出口／貨幣限制

examples.en: speed/parking restrictions
examples.trans: 速度／停車限制

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự hạn chế, sự thu hẹp, sự giới hạn; r. of a function sự thu hẹp của một hàm; quantum r. sự giới hạn lượng tử
all_entries.translation_zh: 受（尤指官方）限制的，受約束的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: limiting the freedom of someone or preventing something from growing

examples.en: He is self-employed because he finds working for other people too restrictive.
examples.trans: 他是個自僱人士，因為他覺得在別人手下工作太不自由。

examples.en: The college is not able to expand because of restrictive planning laws.
examples.trans: 由於限制性規劃法規，這所大學無法擴建。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hạn chế, giới hạn, thu hẹp

all_entries.domain: Kinh tế, Tài chính, Thương mại & Kế toán (Business, Finance & Economics)
all_entries.definition_en: to organize a company, business, or system in a new way to make it operate more effectively

examples.en: The government restructured the coal industry before selling it to private owners.
examples.trans: 在將煤炭行業進行私有化之前，政府對其進行了結構調整。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cơ cấu lại; tổ chức lại; sắp xếp lại

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: If an activity resumes, or if you resume it, it starts again after a pause.

examples.en: Normal services will be resumed in the spring.
examples.trans: 春天將恢復正常服務。

examples.en: [ + -ing verb ] He stopped to take a sip of water and then resumed speaking.
examples.trans: 他停下來呷了一口水，然後繼續發言。

all_entries.meaning_vi: lấy lại, chiếm lại, hồi phục lại; lại bắt đầu, lại tiếp tục (sau khi nghỉ, dừng); tóm tắt lại, nêu điểm chính

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.en: The job is open to applicants with over two years' experience in retail.
examples.trans: 這份工作面向有兩年以上零售經驗的應徵者。

examples.en: The clothing company has six retail outlets (= shops) in Perth.
examples.trans: 這間服裝公司在珀斯開設了六家零售店。

all_entries.meaning_vi: Bán lẻ.

all_entries.domain: Kinh tế, Tài chính, Thương mại & Kế toán (Business, Finance & Economics)

examples.trans: 大型電子産品零售店

all_entries.meaning_vi: người bán lẻ; người phao (tin đồn)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)

examples.trans: 她被打敗了，失去了繼續掌管公司的權力。

examples.en: He managed to retain his dignity throughout the performance.
examples.trans: 在整個表演過程中，他設法保持了自己的尊嚴。

all_entries.meaning_vi: giữ, cầm lại; ghi nhớ; thuê (luật sư)

examples.trans: 兩位有影響的參議員主張保留這項不得人心的稅收。

examples.en: The retention of old technology has slowed the company's growth.
examples.trans: 死守著舊技術不放減緩了這家公司的發展。

all_entries.meaning_vi: sự giữ lại, sự cầm lại; sự duy trì; sự ghi nhớ; trí nhớ

all_entries.definition_en: to think again about a plan, idea, or system in order to change or improve it

examples.en: Her family's disapproval made her rethink her plans.
examples.trans: 家人的反對使她不得不重新考慮自己的計劃。

examples.en: [ + question word ] The European Commission is having to rethink how it can maintain farmers' incomes while cutting costs and excess production.
examples.trans: 歐盟委員會現在不得不重新考慮如何在減少開支和生產過剩的同時保障農民的收入不下降。

examples.trans: 她大叫著衝向我時，我就後退（到了桌子後面）。

all_entries.definition_en: to find and bring back something

examples.trans: 我們教狗撿球。

examples.en: Computers are used to store and retrieve information efficiently.
examples.trans: 電腦用於快速高效地存儲和檢索資訊。

examples.en: In retrospect, I think my marriage was doomed from the beginning.
examples.trans: 現在回頭看，我覺得我的婚姻從一開始就註定要破裂。

examples.en: I'm sure my university days seem happier in retrospect than they really were.
examples.trans: 我敢說，回顧我的大學時光，看起來肯定要比當時實際生活幸福。

examples.trans: 把這些種子種進約三公分深的地方。

examples.en: The chemical will stop all seeds from sprouting (= starting to grow).
examples.trans: 這種化學製品可制止種子發芽。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hạt, hạt giống; tinh dịch; con cháu, hậu thế

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to try or attempt

examples.en: "Are you actively seeking jobs?" she asked.
examples.trans: 「你在積極找工作嗎？」她問。

examples.en: Hundreds of dissidents are seeking refuge/asylum in the US embassy.
examples.trans: 數百異議分子到美國大使館尋求庇護。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tìm tòi; cố gắng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: appearing to be something, especially when this is not true
all_entries.translation: 貌似；看似；（尤指）表面上地

examples.en: He remains confident and seemingly untroubled by his recent problems.
examples.trans: 他依然自信如初，似乎沒有被最近的問題所困擾。

examples.en: The factory closure is seemingly inevitable.
examples.trans: 看來，工廠關閉勢在難免。

all_entries.meaning_vi: cỏ vẻ, ra vẻ, tưởng chừng như
all_entries.translation_zh: 貌似；看似；（尤指）表面上地

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to take using sudden force

examples.en: I seized his arm and made him turn to look at me.
examples.trans: 我抓住他的手臂，使他轉身看著我。

examples.en: He seized the chance/opportunity of a free flight with both hands (= with eagerness or enthusiasm).
examples.trans: 他急切地緊抓住搭乘免費航班的機會。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chiếm đoạt, cướp lấy, nắm lấy; tóm bắt (ai); nắm vững, hiểu thấu

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: intentionally choosing some things and not others
all_entries.translation: 有選擇性的；嚴格篩選的

examples.en: As a teacher she was very selective, accepting only a small number of exceptionally gifted pupils.
examples.trans: 作爲老師，她的篩選很嚴格，只接受一小部分特別有天賦的學生。

examples.en: He seemed to have a very selective recall of past events.
examples.trans: 他好像只能選擇性地回想起過去的事情。

all_entries.meaning_vi: chọn, lựa
all_entries.translation_zh: 有選擇性的；嚴格篩選的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: plural selves the set of someone's characteristics, such as personality and ability, that are not physical and make that person different from other people

examples.en: The hero of the movie finally finds his true self (= discovers what his true personality and feelings are).
examples.trans: 電影的主角最後找到了真正的自我。

examples.en: When I saw them this afternoon they were more like their old/normal selves (= as they were in the past).
examples.trans: 我今天下午見到他們的時候，他們更像是平時的老樣子了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: đồng màu, cùng màu; một màu (hoa); cùng loại

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: having confidence in your own abilities

examples.en: The interview showed her as a self-assured and mature student.
examples.trans: 面試顯示出她是個自信成熟的學生。

all_entries.meaning_vi: có tự tin / tự tin

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: good knowledge and judgment about yourself
all_entries.meaning_vi: tự nhận thức

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: (of a holiday) having cooking facilities available so that you can cook meals for yourself rather than having them provided for you
all_entries.translation: 自供伙食的（假日），自己做飯的（假期）

examples.en: a self-catering holiday
examples.trans: 自己做飯的假期

examples.en: We decided to go for self-catering rather than stay in a hotel.
examples.trans: 我們決定找一個能夠自己煮飯的住處，而不是住在賓館裡。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thức ăn / bữa ăn
all_entries.translation_zh: 自供伙食的（假日），自己做飯的（假期）

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: only interested in yourself and your own activities
all_entries.translation: 以自我爲中心的；自私自利的

examples.en: Robert is a self-centred, ambitious, and bigoted man.
examples.trans: 羅伯特是個自私自利、野心勃勃而又食古不化的傢夥。

all_entries.meaning_vi: mọi thứ vì bản thân và lợi ích cá nhân (thành ngữ); không quan tâm đến người khác / ích kỷ / vụ lợi
all_entries.translation_zh: 以自我爲中心的；自私自利的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: nervous or uncomfortable because you are worried about what people think about you or your actions

examples.en: He looked uncomfortable, like a self-conscious adolescent.
examples.trans: 他看起來不太自在，好似一個局促不安的少年。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bất an / không thoải mái

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the ability to make yourself do things you know you should do even when you do not want to
all_entries.translation: 自律；自我約束能力；自製力

examples.en: You need a lot of self-discipline when you're doing research work on your own.
examples.trans: 獨自做研究工作的時候，需要高度的自我約束力。

all_entries.meaning_vi: hạn chế / giới hạn / ràng buộc / sự hạn chế / sự ràng buộc
all_entries.translation_zh: 自律；自我約束能力；自製力

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: belief and confidence in your own ability and value

examples.en: The compliments she received after the presentation boosted her self-esteem.
examples.trans: 發言後得到的讚譽增強了她的自尊心。

examples.en: She suffers from low self-esteem and it prevents her from pursuing her goals.
examples.trans: 她的自尊心低，對她追求目標構成阻礙。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự tôn / tự trọng / cái tôi / tự hào

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: rich and successful as a result of your own work and not because of family money
all_entries.translation: 靠自己奮鬥成功的，白手起家的

examples.en: a self-made man/millionaire
examples.trans: 靠自我奮鬥成功的男子／百萬富翁

all_entries.meaning_vi: (thành ngữ) gây dựng từ hai bàn tay trắng; bắt đầu từ con số không
all_entries.translation_zh: 靠自己奮鬥成功的，白手起家的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: not needing help or support from other people

examples.en: Single parents have to be self-reliant and inventive.
examples.trans: 單親父母必須懂得自力更生，還要富有創造力。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tái sinh nhờ nỗ lực của chính mình (thành ngữ) / tự lực cánh sinh

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a feeling of respect for yourself that shows that you value yourself

examples.en: He felt what he was being asked to do took away his dignity and self-respect.
examples.trans: 他覺得別人叫他做的事情使他顔面掃地，很傷自尊。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự tôn / tự trọng / cái tôi / tự hào

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: able to provide everything you need, especially food, for yourself without the help of other people

examples.en: The programme aims to make the country self-sufficient in food production and to cut energy imports.
examples.trans: 這個企劃案旨在使國家在糧食上能自給自足，並減少能源進口。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tự cung tự cấp

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to persuade someone that an idea or plan is a good one and likely to be successful

examples.en: We'll be selling the tickets at/for £50 each.
examples.trans: 我們每張票將賣50英鎊。

examples.en: The stall sells drinks and snacks.
examples.trans: 這個攤位賣飲料和小吃。

all_entries.meaning_vi: bán, thương mại

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: A house that is semi-detached is one that is joined to another similar house on only one side.

examples.en: They live in a semi-detached house.
examples.trans: 他們住在一所半獨立式的房子裡。

all_entries.meaning_vi: nhà / tòa nhà (một hoặc hai tầng) / căn hộ / phòng

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to cause someone or something to do a particular thing, or to cause something to happen

examples.en: [ + two objects ] I'll send her a letter/email/parcel/postcard next week.
examples.trans: 我下週要給她寄信／電子郵件／包裹／明信片。

examples.en: We'll send it by post/airmail/sea.
examples.trans: 我們將用郵寄／航空／海運的方式發送。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phát đi

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to send someone a message asking them to come to see you

examples.en: Do you think we should send for a doctor?
examples.trans: 你覺得我們應該去請醫生嗎？

all_entries.meaning_vi: một người nào đó / một người nhất định / một số người / tôi (xưng hô sau họ của một người)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to produce something in a way that causes it to spread out from a central point

examples.en: The equipment sent out a regular high-pitched signal.
examples.trans: 這個設備發出有規律的高音訊號。

examples.en: The torch sends out a powerful beam of light.
examples.trans: 手電筒發出一束強光。

all_entries.meaning_vi: thả ra / phát ra

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: approving very good, exciting, or unusual

examples.en: a sensational sports car/dress
examples.trans: 極好的跑車／連衣裙

examples.en: She looks sensational (= extremely attractive) in her new dress.
examples.trans: 她穿上新裙子漂亮極了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: gây xúc động mạnh làm náo động dư luận, giật gân

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: disapproving Sensational news reports and articles are intended to be shocking and exciting rather than serious.
all_entries.translation: （新聞報導或文章）意在引起轟動的，聳人聽聞的

examples.en: a sensational sports car/dress
examples.trans: 極好的跑車／連衣裙

examples.en: She looks sensational (= extremely attractive) in her new dress.
examples.trans: 她穿上新裙子漂亮極了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: gây xúc động mạnh làm náo động dư luận, giật gân
all_entries.translation_zh: （新聞報導或文章）意在引起轟動的，聳人聽聞的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to feel or experience something without being able to explain exactly how

examples.en: With her excellent sense of smell, she could tell if you were a smoker from the other side of the room.
examples.trans: 她嗅覺靈敏，在房間的另一端就能知道你是否抽煙。

examples.en: My cold is so bad I've lost my sense of smell/taste (= I can't smell/taste anything).
examples.trans: 我感冒很嚴重，聞不到任何氣味了／嚐不出任何味道了。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phương, chiều, ý nghĩa; s. of describing the boundary chiều đi trên biên; s. of an inequality chiều của một bất đẳng thức

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: not having good judgment or a good or useful purpose
all_entries.translation: 不明智的；無意義的；愚蠢的

examples.en: a senseless argument
examples.trans: 無意義的爭論

examples.en: Panos was beaten senseless by the burglars.
examples.trans: 帕諾斯被竊賊們打得不省人事。

all_entries.meaning_vi: không có cảm giác, bất tỉnh; không có nghĩa, vô nghĩa; điên rồ, ngu dại
all_entries.translation_zh: 不明智的；無意義的；愚蠢的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: an understanding of or ability to decide about what is good or valuable, especially in connection with artistic or social activities
all_entries.translation: （尤指藝術或社會活動方面的）鑒賞力，感受能力

examples.en: literary/musical/artistic/theatrical/aesthetic sensibility
examples.trans: 文學／音樂／藝術／戲劇／美學鑒賞力

examples.en: The author has applied a modern sensibility (= way of understanding things) to the social ideals of an earlier age.
examples.trans: 作者對較早期的社會理想採用了一種現代的理解方法。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tri giác, cảm giác; tính đa cảm, tính dễ cảm; sự nhạy cảm
all_entries.translation_zh: （尤指藝術或社會活動方面的）鑒賞力，感受能力

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: in a sensible or practical way
all_entries.translation: 明智合理地；切合實際地

examples.en: The police praised motorists for driving sensibly in the appalling conditions.
examples.trans: 警方稱許駕駛人在惡劣的條件下能謹慎駕駛。

examples.en: She wasn't very sensibly dressed for hiking.
examples.trans: 對於徒步穿越荒野來說，她的穿著不太合適。

all_entries.meaning_vi: một cách hợp lý
all_entries.translation_zh: 明智合理地；切合實際地

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: an ability to understand what other people need, and be helpful and kind to them

examples.en: The police showed commendable sensitivity in their handling of the case.
examples.trans: 警方在處理該案時表現出高度敏銳性，值得讚揚。

examples.en: I should have warned you about her sensitivity to criticism.
examples.trans: 我早該警告你，她對別人的批評十分敏感。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tính dễ cảm xúc; tính nhạy cảm; tính nhạy; độ nhạy

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: the quality of being easily upset by the things people say or do, or causing people to be upset, embarrassed, or angry
all_entries.translation: 神經過敏；易被冒犯；敏感

examples.en: The police showed commendable sensitivity in their handling of the case.
examples.trans: 警方在處理該案時表現出高度敏銳性，值得讚揚。

examples.en: I should have warned you about her sensitivity to criticism.
examples.trans: 我早該警告你，她對別人的批評十分敏感。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tính dễ cảm xúc; tính nhạy cảm; tính nhạy; độ nhạy
all_entries.translation_zh: 神經過敏；易被冒犯；敏感

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: formal a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something

examples.en: Nationalist sentiment has increased in the area since the bombing.
examples.trans: 爆炸案發生以來，該地區的民族主義情緒開始高漲。

examples.en: I don't think she shares my sentiments.
examples.trans: 我認爲她不同意我的觀點。

all_entries.meaning_vi: tình, tình cảm; cảm nghĩ, ý kiến; tính chất truyền cảm (trong nghệ thuật)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: A sentimental person is strongly influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.
all_entries.translation: 多愁善感的；感情用事的

examples.en: Why be sentimental about that old coat? There's no point in keeping it just because you were wearing it when you first met me.
examples.trans: 爲甚麽對那件舊外套依依不捨？僅僅因爲你第一次遇到我時穿著這件衣服就留著它，這毫無意義。

examples.en: It's a cheap ring but it has great sentimental value for me.
examples.trans: 這只戒指不貴，但對我來說卻有很大的紀念價值。

all_entries.meaning_vi: dễ cảm, đa cảm, nhiều tình cảm uỷ mị; cảm tình
all_entries.translation_zh: 多愁善感的；感情用事的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a series of related things or events, or the order in which they follow each other
all_entries.translation: 一連串；一系列；順序，次序

examples.en: The first chapter describes the strange sequence of events that led to his death.
examples.trans: 第一章描述了造成他死亡的一連串奇特事件。

examples.en: Is there a particular sequence in which you have to perform these tasks?
examples.trans: 你是否得按一定的順序完成這些任務？

all_entries.meaning_vi: dãy; s. of functions dãy hàm; s. of homomorphisms dãy đồng cấu
all_entries.translation_zh: 一連串；一系列；順序，次序

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: peaceful and calm; worried by nothing

examples.en: She has a lovely serene face.
examples.trans: 她長著一張可愛而安詳的臉。

all_entries.meaning_vi: trong, sáng sủa, quang tạnh (trời); yên lặng, không sóng gió (biển); trầm lặng; thanh bình, thanh thản

all_entries.domain: Luật pháp, Tư pháp & Chính sách (Law, Legal & Governance)
all_entries.definition_en: used to describe a person who repeatedly commits a similar crime or carries out a similar bad act, or the crime or act itself
all_entries.translation: （重罪案犯或重案）連環的，連續的

examples.en: She wrote a thriller about a brutal serial killer/murderer.
examples.trans: 她寫了部有關一名冷血連環殺手的驚悚小說。

examples.en: a serial adulterer/womaniser
examples.trans: 連續犯案的強姦犯／沉湎女色難以自拔的人

all_entries.meaning_vi: chuỗi, loạt
all_entries.translation_zh: （重罪案犯或重案）連環的，連續的

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: a story on television or radio or in a newspaper, etc. that is broadcast or printed in separate parts
all_entries.translation: （電視或廣播）連續劇；（報紙上的）連載故事

examples.en: She wrote a thriller about a brutal serial killer/murderer.
examples.trans: 她寫了部有關一名冷血連環殺手的驚悚小說。

examples.en: a serial adulterer/womaniser
examples.trans: 連續犯案的強姦犯／沉湎女色難以自拔的人

all_entries.meaning_vi: chuỗi, loạt
all_entries.translation_zh: （電視或廣播）連續劇；（報紙上的）連載故事

all_entries.domain: Kinh tế, Tài chính, Thương mại & Kế toán (Business, Finance & Economics)
all_entries.definition_en: to work for; to do your duty to

examples.en: Do they serve meals in the bar?
examples.trans: 這家酒吧提供飯菜嗎？

examples.en: We arrived at the hotel and were served with champagne and canapés.
examples.trans: 我們到達旅館後，旅館提供了香檳和小吃。

all_entries.meaning_vi: phục vụ, thoả mãn; xử lý, điều khiển (máy)

all_entries.domain: Học thuật & Từ vựng nâng cao (Academic & Advanced Vocabulary)
all_entries.definition_en: to help achieve something or to be useful as something

examples.en: Do they serve meals in the bar?

examples.trans: 失去工作已經夠糟，但被房東趕出門後我徹底崩潰了。

all_entries.translation: 最後一次聽到有關（某人或某事）的任何消息；最後一次見到他／她／它

examples.trans: 然後他就去了波士頓，那是我最後一次見到他。
